sa: क्रुद्धस्तैरमुत्प्लुत्य दृष्टमात्रः प्लवंगमैः। गृहीतोऽस्म्यपि चारब्धो हन्तुं लोप्तुं च मुष्टिभिः॥
en: Thereat, as soon as they saw me, the monkeys flying into a wrath, captured me, and attempted to clip my wings and slay me with their clenched fists.

sa: हाहाकारो महानासीत् पुत्राणां ते विशाम्पते। दृष्ट्वा शक्तिं महाघोरां मृत्योर्दण्डसमप्रभाम्॥
en: O king, then loud cries of “Oh” and “Alas" rose among your sons when they saw that fearful dart which was as effulgent as the rod of death.

sa: ततः प्रहर्षः सैन्यानां तवाप्यासीद् विशाम्पते। वादित्राणां ध्वनिश्चोग्रः सिंहनादरवै: सह॥
en: Thereupon, O ruler of men, your warriors were filled with delight and the war-cries they then shouted out, became mingled with the terrible din of the musical instruments.

sa: तेषां च रक्षणार्थाय युध्यते फाल्गुनः परैः। एतज्ञात्वा महाबाहो कार्यद्वयमुपस्थितम्॥
en: For the protection of these latter, Falguna is engaged with the foe. Having heard, O mighty armed hero, of these two tasks both of which demand prompt attention,

sa: स हताश्वादवप्लुत्य स्यन्दनाद्धतसारथिः। आरुरोह रथं तूर्णं पुत्रस्य रथिनां वरः॥
en: Thereat that foremost of car-warrior viz., Virata, jumping down from his chariot of which the driver and the steeds had been slain, swiftly ascended the car of Sankha.

sa: भीष्म उवाच पश्यध्वमुपधानं मे पाण्डवेनाभिसंधितम्। शिश्येऽहमस्यां शय्यायां यावदावर्तनं रवेः॥
en: Bhishma said Behold you all, the son of Pandu has supplied me with! I shall lie on this bed until the sun rolls back to the Northern solstice.

sa: भीष्मद्रोणौ कृपश्चैव सौबलश्च जयद्रथः। द्रौणिर्वाऽपि महेष्वासो विकर्णो वा महाबलः॥
en: Bhishma, Drona, Kripa and the son of Subala, and Jayadratha, and the mighty bowman the son of Drona, and the mighty Vikarna, what did all these warriors do?

sa: स रथानीकवान् व्यूहो हस्त्यङ्गो नृपशीर्षवान्। वाजिपक्षः पतत्युग्रः प्रहसन् सर्वतोमुखः॥ द्रोणेन विहितो राजन् राज्ञा शान्तनवेन च। तथैवाचार्यपुत्रेण बाह्नीकेन कृपेण च॥
en: O king, Vyuhas (particular formation), consisting of many cars were arrayed by Drona, and the royal son of Shantanu and Drona's son and Balhika and Kripa; the elephants formed the bodies, the wing, the heads and the horses the kings. With face towards all sides, that fearful Vyuha seemed to smile. It appeared to be ready to leap forward.

sa: स गाढविद्धो व्यथितस्तोत्रादित इव द्विपः। उत्पपात तदाऽऽकाशं समन्ताद् वैनतेयवत्॥
en: Thus pierced sore, and greatly afflicted like an elephant smitten with the hook, the Rakshasa then at once rose to the sky like the son of Vainatay Garuda,

sa: तच्च पाशुपतं घोरं प्रतिज्ञायाश्च पारणम्। ततः पाशुपतं दिव्यमवाप्य पुनरीश्वरात्॥
en: He also granted him the terrible Pasupata weapon and the fulfilment of his vow. Then having obtained the Pasupata weapon of celestial make, once more, from the Lord.

sa: सर्वभूतानि कौन्तेय प्रकृतिं यान्ति मामिकाम्। कल्पक्षये पुनस्तानि कल्पादौ विसृजाम्यहम्॥
en: All entities, O son of Kunti,, attain to My nature at the end of a Kalpa. And again at the beginning of a Kalpa I bring them forth.

sa: अथ शान्तनवो राजन्नभ्यधावद् धनंजयम्। प्रगृह्य कार्मुकं घोरं कालदण्डोपमं रणे॥
en: O king, taking up a fearful bow that resembled the rod of death himself, the son of Shantanu, Bhishma, rushed upon Dhananjaya (Arjuna) on the field of battle.

sa: क्षत्रधर्मा तु राजेन्द्र मतो मेऽर्धरथो नृप। धृष्टद्युम्नस्य तनयो बाल्यानातिकृतश्रमः॥
en: The of Dhrishtadyumna, Kshatradharman, O chief among kings, is in my opinion only half a Ratha, O ruler of men, owing to his youth and want of training.

sa: यथावलं यथोत्साहं रथिनः समुपादिशत्। अर्जुनं सूतपुत्राय भीमं दुर्योधनाय च॥
en: He gave instructions to car warriors each according to his strength and energy; and he appointed Arjuna to fight with the son of a Suta. Bhima with Duryodhana,

sa: इत्युक्त्वाऽतर्हिता राजन् सर्व एव द्विजोत्तमाः। अष्टौ सदृशरूपास्ते सर्वे भासुरमूर्तयः॥
en: Having said this all those best of Brahmanas vanished, O king. They were eight in number, resembling one another in appearance, and shone brightly, having no material bodies.

sa: छित्त्वा शक्तिं तु गाङ्गेयः सात्यकिं नवभिः शरैः। आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धः प्रसञ्छत्रुकर्शनः॥ ततः सरथनागाश्वाः पाण्डवाः पाण्डुपूर्वजाः। परिववू रणे भीष्मं माघवत्राणकारणात्॥
en: With two sharp arrows having horse shoeheads; and the lance fell down on the ground. Having severed that lance, the son of Ganga, that grinder of foes, waxing wroth and smiling the while, pierced Satyaki on the breast with nine arrows. Thereupon with all their chariots, elephants and horses, the Pandavas, O elder brother of Pandu,

sa: शरान् विचित्रान् सुबहून् रुक्मपुङ्खान्छिलाशितान्। मुमोच शतशः क्रुद्धो गभस्तीनिव भास्करः॥
en: Then like the lustrous orb shooting his rays, he, excited with wrath, shot hundreds of diverse kinds of arrows, all whetted on stone and furnished with golden wings.

sa: तौ तज्ज्गृहतुः प्रीतौ धनुर्बाणं च सुप्रभम्। आजह्रतुर्महात्मानौ ददतुश्च महात्मने॥
en: Then highly delighted, they both took up those effulgent weapons, the bow and the arrow. Then those two high-souled ones, gave that bow and to the illustrious Mahadeva.

sa: स देवदत्तमादाय शङ्ख हेमपरिष्कृतम्। दध्मौ वेगेन महता घोषेणापूरयन् दिशः॥
en: Thereafter taken up his conch known as Devadatta of the effulgence of gold, he blew it with great force, filling the points of the compass with the blare.

sa: यं दृष्ट्वा कुरवः सर्वे दुर्योधनपुरोगमाः। निवर्तिष्यन्ति संत्रस्ताः सिहं क्षुद्रमृगा यथा॥ तं सर्वे संश्रयिष्यामः प्राकारमकुतोभयाः। भीमं प्रहरतां श्रेष्ठं देवराजमिवामराः॥
en: That foremost of all warriors, Bhima, will lead us, seeing whom all the warriors, headed by Duryodhana, will fly in terror as small animals fly at the sight of a lion. Our fears being all dispelled, we shall all seck his shelter as if he were a wall, as the celestial seeks the shelter of Indra."

sa: सत्यधर्मरतो दान्तो विप्रपूजादिभिर्गुणैः। सदैव त्रिदिवं प्राप्तो राजा किल युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: King Yudhishthira is constantly in the enjoyment of heavenly bliss, in consequence of his devotion to truth, righteousness, control passions, worship of the Vipras and such other qualities.

sa: स्वस्ति तेऽस्त्वेकपादेभ्यो बहुपादेभ्य एव च। स्वस्तयस्त्वपादकेभ्यश्च नित्यं तव महारणे॥
en: May you obtain blessing from creatures having one leg only and creatures having many also! May you also get blessings from those who have no legs at all!

sa: सारथिं दशभिश्चास्य ध्वजं चैकेन चिच्छिदे॥ सोऽन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय गाङ्गेयो वेगवत्तरम्।
en: He then pierced the latter's charioteer with ten shafts and with another one shaft cut off his standard. Then Ganga's son took up another bow of superior toughness.

sa: तस्य काञ्चनसूत्रस्थः शरैः संछादितो मणिः। रराजोरसि खे सूर्यो ग्रहैरवि समावृतः॥ पुत्रस्तु तव तेजस्वी भीमसेनेन पाडितः। नामृष्यत यथा नागस्तलशब्दं मदोत्कटः॥
en: Thereupon the gem that was hanging in the breast of Duryodhana by golden threads, being surrounded by those arrows appeared charming like the sun in the heavens surrounded by the planets. But your son endued with great energy, thus pierced by Bhimasena, did not brook it cooly, like a snake not bearing the sound of the tread of man.

sa: चत्वारस्तेन मे वाहाः सूतश्चैव विशाम्पते। पर्तिरुद्धास्तथैवाहं समरे दंशितः स्थितः॥
en: By that shower, my four horses as also my chariot, O lord of the universe, completely covered; but clad in a coat of mail, I myself remained calm.

sa: स हताश्वे रथे तिष्ठन् मद्राधिपतिरायसीम्। उत्तरान्तकरी शक्तिं चिक्षेप भुजगोपमाम्॥
en: The king of Madra,. staying on the car the horses of which had been killed, hurled an iron dart, which resembled a snake, in order to kill Uttara.

sa: गजा हयाः पदाताश्च विमिश्रा दन्तिभिर्हताः। रथाश्वाः दन्तिनश्चैव पत्तिभिस्तत्र सूदिताः॥
en: Horses and elephants, and foot-soldiers, mixing with one another, was siain by the tuskers; and car-warriors, and horse-soldiers, and tuskers were also slain in that battle by foot-soldiers.

sa: पूर्वं कृतयुगं नाम ततस्त्रेतायुगं प्रभो। संक्षेपाद् द्वापरस्याथ ततस्तिष्यं प्रवर्तते॥
en: The first of the Yugas in Krita. O lord, after the expire of the Krita comes Treta, after Treta comes Dvapara. after the last of all comes Kali.

sa: यदि तेऽहमनुग्राह्यो भ्रातृभिः सह केशव। स्वधर्मस्याविरोधेन हितं व्याहर केशव॥
en: If, indeed, I and my brothers be worthy of your grace, then O Keshava, advice me what will be beneficial to me, without clashing against our prescribed duties.

sa: एको दीर्णो दारयति सेनां सुमहतीमपि। तां दीर्णामनुदीर्यन्ते योधाः शूरतरा
en: One soldier, struck with panic, can cause a large army to be alarmed and to take to flight, it causes even the bravest of warriors to be frightened.

sa: अर्करश्मिविमिश्रेषु शस्त्रेषु कवचेषु च। चढूंषि प्रत्यहन्यन्त सैन्येन रजसा तथा॥
en: Our eyes were then dazzled and blinded by the weapons and armours on which the sun's rays were reflected, as also by the dust raised by the troops.

sa: पुरा ह्येष हरिभूत्वा विकुण्ठोऽकुण्ठसायकः। सुरासुरानवस्फूर्णन्नब्रवीत् के जयन्त्विति॥ कथं कृष्णं जयेमेति यैरुक्तं तत्र तैर्जितम्। तत् प्रसादाद्धि त्रैलोक्यं प्राप्तं शक्रादिभिः सुरैः॥
en: In the days of yore, indestructible and invincible. Hari appeared and thus spoke loudly to the celestial and the Asuras, “who amongst you would be victorious?” The conquered (the celestial) said, “With Krishna in front we shall win victory”. It was through the grace of Hari that the celestial headed by Indra obtained (the sovereignty) of the three worlds.

sa: सर्ववर्णाश्च जायन्ते सदा चैव च द्वापरे। महोत्साहा वीर्यवन्तः परस्परजयैषिणः॥
en: O kings, when Dvapara comes in, all the four orders of men become capable of great exertions. They possess great energy and they desire to conquer one another.

sa: अनासाद्य तु वार्ष्णेयं शक्तिः परमदारुणा। न्यपतद् धरणीपृष्ठे महोल्केव महाप्रभा॥
en: That high formed hero of the Vrishni race baffled it with the swiftness (of his movements); and that dreadful lance, even without reaching him of the Vrishni race,

sa: तस्य ज्यातलनिर्घोषं विस्फूर्जितमिवाशनेः। वित्रेसुः सर्वभूतानि सर्वे श्रुत्वा च पार्थिवाः॥
en: Then hearing the twang of his bow and the slap of his arms that resembled the rumble of thunder, the troops and kings there, were inspired with terror.

sa: हेमन्तान्तेऽशोक एव रक्तस्तबकमण्डितः। बभौ रामस्तथा राजन् प्रफुल्ल इव किंशुकः॥
en: He looked like the Ashoka tree, at the end of winter, covered with bunches of red flowers or, O king, like the Kinshuka tree when laden with flowers.

sa: अर्धचन्द्रं च संधाय सुतीक्ष्ण लोमवाहिनम्। भीमसेनस्य चिच्छेद चापं क्रोधसमन्वितः॥
en: Fixing on his bow string a crescent shaped and exceedingly sharp arrow furnished with wings of down, and inflamed with rage, he burst asunder the bow of Bhimasena.

sa: साधु साध्विति सर्वत्र निश्चेरुः स्तुतिसंहिताः। वाचः पुण्याः कीर्तिमतां मनोहृदयहर्षणाः॥
en: "Excellent", Excellent" were the words shouted everywhere. Eulogistic hymns for those illustrious men were chanted by all. The minds and hearts of every one were attracted towards them.

sa: द्रोणभीष्मौ तु संक्रुद्धावापतन्तौ महाबलौ। प्रत्युद्ययौ शिखण्डी तु महेष्वासो महाहवे॥
en: Then in that fierce battle, the mighty bowman Shikhandin rushed against Bhishma and Drona, both of great prowess, who inflamed with wrath, had fallen upon his own troops.

sa: त्रासयिष्यति बाणानां कुरुनन्यांश्च पार्थिवान्। समिद्धोऽग्निर्यथा वीर महाज्वालो दुमान् दहेत्॥
en: Today the whizzle, resembling the rumble of thunders, of arrows shot from the Gandiva, will strike terror into the hearts of the Kurus and other rulers of earth.

sa: नराणां चैव कायेभ्यः शिरसां पततां रणे। शुश्रुवे सुमहाञ्छब्दः पततामश्मनामिव॥
en: A defending noise, like that produced by a shower of stones, was heard there, as the heads of the combatants fell on the field severed from their trunks.

sa: ऋषयस्त्वथ देवाश्च दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्माणमुत्थितम्। स्थिताः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे पश्यन्तो महदद्भुतम्॥
en: Also the sages and the celestial beholding the figure thus revealed in the heavens stood with hands folded and with their gaze fixed on the marvel of marvels.

sa: तत्रासीत् तुमुलं युद्धं तावकानां परैः सह॥ दशमेऽहनि राजेन्द्र भीष्मार्जुनसमागमे।
en: Then on that the tenth day when Bhishma and Arjuna contested with one another, fierce was the fight that regard between your soldiers and those of the enemy.

sa: ततो रुद्रो जटी स्थाणुर्निशाचरपतिहरः। जगाम शरणं देवं ब्रह्मणं परमेष्ठिनम्॥
en: Thereupon Hara, otherwise called Sthanu, wearing matted locks on his head, that Lord of all the night-rangers, sought shelter from the divine Brahma that foremost of all gods.

sa: तं दीप्तमिव कालाग्निं दण्डहस्तमिवान्तकम्। जवेनाभ्यपतद् भीमः प्रगृह्य महतीं गदाम्॥
en: Thereupon Bhima also grasping a mighty mace speedily encountered him (Shalya) who then resembled the all-destroying fire in effulgence and also the God of death wielding his bludgecn.

sa: संचिच्छिदतुरप्यस्य ध्वज कार्मुकमेव च। अथान्यद् धनुरुदाय हार्दिक्य: क्रोधमूर्छितः॥ कृत्वा विधनुषौ वीरौ शरवर्शेरवाकिरत्। तावन्ये धनुषी सज्ये कृत्वा भोज विजघ्नतुः॥
en: Cut off Kritavarman's bow and standard. Thereat furious with rage and taking up another bow, the son of Hridika. Deprived both those warriors of the use of their bow and shrouded them in a net-work of arrows. They both in a moment having strung another pair of bows, began to strike the king of the Bhojas.

sa: जितो येन रणे रामो भवता वीर्यशालिना। क्षत्रियान्तकरो घोरो देवदानवदर्पहा॥
en: You who, endowed with great prowess, had defeated in battle, Rama, that terrible destroyer of the Kshatriya race, held in high honour by the celestials and the Asuras.

sa: वयं पार्थं हनिष्यामो भीष्मद्रोणपुरोगमाः। स एवमुक्तो बलवान् राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान्॥
en: We on the other hand headed by Bhishma and Drona shall slay Arjuna in battle.” Thus spoken to that prince of the Rakshasas, possessed of might and prowess,

sa: एतच्छ्रुतं मया तात ऋषीणां भावितात्मनाम्। वासुदेवं कथयतां समवाये पुरातनम्॥
en: It was this, O sire, that was heard by me from the sages of accomplished understanding when they were speaking of Vasudeva the ancient one, among their assembly.

sa: हाहाकारश्च संजयज्ञे तव सैन्यस्य मारिष। वध्यतो भीमसेनेन कृतिना चित्रयोधिना॥
en: Cries of 'Oh and 'Alas'. O sire, arose from the ranks of your soldiers, as they were slaughtered by the accomplished Bhima versed in diverse modes of warfare.

sa: तमागस्कारिणं रामः पौलस्त्यमजितं परैः॥ जघान समरे क्रुद्धः पुरेव त्र्यम्बकोऽन्धकम्।
en: That son of Paulastya invincible by his enemies who had injured him, Rama slew in battle, being excited with rage, like the threeeyed Mahadeva slaying the demon Andhaka.

sa: सत्यश्रवा रथस्त्वेको राजपुत्रो बृहद्बलः। तव राजन् रिपुबले कालवत् प्रचरिष्यति॥
en: Satyashravas that prince of great strength, is a Ratha on your side, ( king and he will work havoc among the armies of the enemies like Death himself.

sa: स गाढविद्धो व्यथितो रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्। मोहितं वीक्ष्य राजानं नीलमध्चयोपमम्॥
en: Thus deeply pierced and sorely pained, Nila squatted down on the terrace of his car. Beholding king Nila, of appearance like a mass of blue clouds, thus confounded,

sa: ततः प्रहर्षयन् सेनां सिंहवद् विनदन् मुहुः। समादत्तार्जुनिस्तूर्णे पौरवान्तकरं शरम्॥
en: Thus imparting delight to his own troops and repeatedly uttering leonine roars, Arjuna's son quickly took in his hand a shaft that was sure to cause Paurava's death.

sa: भीष्मेण धार्तराष्ट्राणां व्यूढः प्रत्युङ्मुखो युधि। मण्डलः स महाव्यूहो दुर्भेद्योऽमित्रघातनः॥
en: Then that mighty and impenetrable Mandala, array of those slayers of enemies viz., the sons of Dhritarashtra, formed by Bhishma himself, began to march forward facing the west.

sa: उवाच चैव गोविन्दमसम्भ्रान्तेन चेतसा। एह्येहि पुण्डरीकाक्ष देवदेव नमोऽस्तु ते॥
en: Then addressing Govinda with a dauntless heart, he said "Come, come, O you of eyes like lotus petals! O god of gods, I do bow down unto you.

sa: चेकितानस्ततः क्रुद्धं पुनश्चिक्षेप तां गदाम्। गौतमस्य वधाकाक्षी वृत्रस्येव पुरंदरः॥
en: Then Chekitana, inflamed with rage and desirous of slaying the son of Gautami, once more hurled that mace at the latter, like Purandara hurling his thunder-bolt at Vritra.

sa: हन्यामहं महाभाग पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम्। दिवसे दिवसे कृत्वा भागं प्रागह्निकं मम॥
en: O highly blessed one, I can slay the army of the Pandavas, by making a division of the day, and taking the morning each day for my share,

sa: अनेनाहं विधानेन संनद्धः सततोत्थितः। क्षपयेयं महत् सैन्यं कालेनानेन भारत॥
en: According to this way, being always with my Armour, and always (spending my time) in action, I can annihilate this huge army in a certain period, O Bharata.

sa: तं सिंहमिव संक्रुद्धं प्रमयन्तं शरैररीन्। आरादायान्तमभ्येत्य वसातीयोऽ ऽभ्ययाद् द्रुतम्॥
en: Thereupon approaching Abhimanyu who, excited with rage, had been crushing the foe with his arrows like a lion crushing other animals, Vasatiya fell upon him with great impetuosity.

sa: रणे। नकुलः सहदेवश्च सात्यकि जुगुपू एवमेष महारौद्रः क्षयार्थं सर्वधन्विनाम्॥
en: Thus for the destruction of all the bowmen, raged the awful battle between your warriors and those of the enemy, in which everybody fought reckless of his life.

sa: वारयस्व रणे यत्तो मिषतां सर्वधन्विनाम्। राक्षसं क्रूरकर्माणं यथेन्द्रस्तारकं पुरा॥
en: Putting forth all your energies do you resist that Rakshasa of cruel deeds before the eyes of these bowmen, even as Indra resisted Taraka in days gone by.

sa: तत् पच्यमानमर्केण द्रोणसायकतापितम्। बभ्राम पार्षतं सैन्यं तत्र तत्रैव भारत॥
en: Scorched by the rays of the sun and felled by the arrows of Drona, the army of the Pandavas, O Bharata, began to reel about on the field.

sa: अपि तन्न मृषाकार्षीत् कच्चित् सत्यपराक्रमः। सम्भ्रान्तानां तदार्तानां त्रस्तानां त्राणमिच्छताम्॥
en: Did that Karna, of infallible prowess in battle, disappoint Duryodhana and his brothers, who had been all exceedingly distressed, panicstruck and anxious for being extricated from their difficulties?

sa: नमो विश्वस्य पतये महतां पतये नमः। नमः सहस्रशिरसे सहस्रभुजमृत्यवे॥
en: Salutations unto him of thousand heads who possesses a thousand arms and who is Death himself. Salutations unto him of thousand eyes and legs, whose deeds are countless.

sa: अश्वत्थामा शान्तनवः सैन्धवोऽथ जयद्रथः। दाक्षिणात्याः प्रतीच्याच पार्वतीयाश्च ये नृपाः॥
en: Then (came) Ashvathama and the son of Shantanu, and Jayadratha of the Sindhu country, and those kings who came from the south and west and other mountainous territories.

sa: व्यचरत् समरे भीमो दण्डपाणिरिवान्तकः॥ गजानां रुधिरक्लिन्नां गदां बिभ्रद् वृकोदरः।
en: Bhima careered in the filed like the Destroyer himself with his mace in his hand. Vrikodara whirling his mace that was drenched with the blood of the elephants.

sa: केशवार्जुनयोर्वाक्यं यथोक्तं सर्वमब्रवीत्॥ कैतव्यस्य तु तद् वाक्यं निशम्य भरतर्षभः।
en: And the speeches of Keshava and Arjuna, all as he had been instructed to say. The foremost of the Bharata race hearing the words of that gambler's son,

sa: कुरवः कर्ण कर्णेति हाहेति च विचुक्रुशुः। तमाधिरथिराक्रन्दं विज्ञाय शरणैषिणाम्॥
en: The son of Adhiratha then hearing those distressful cries of those who deserved his help, proceeded to face Arjuna, saying at the same time, “Be not afraid, Owarriors."

sa: रूपवान् बलसम्पन्नो गुणवान् सत्यविक्रमः। इन्द्रलोकं जगामाशु श्रुत्वा तत्रार्जुनं गतम्॥
en: Hearing that Arjuna Lad come to the regions of Indra, that handsome, highly puissant and accomplished Iravat of prowess that could not be baffled, hide to those regions.

sa: उपसंग्रहणं कृत्वा द्रोणाय स विशाम्पते। उपोपविश्य प्रणतः पर्यपृच्छदिदं तदा॥
en: Then saluting Drona by touching his feet and having bowed down to him, Jayadratha, O ruler of men, sat down with humility and then asked the following question.

sa: तस्याश्वान् गदया हत्वा तयोभौ पार्ष्णसारथी। शराचिताङ्गः सौभद्रः श्वाविद्वत् समदृश्यत॥
en: Slaying with his mace the horses and the two flank-supporters of Ashvatthaman, the son of Subhadra, with his body covered all over with arrows looked like a porcupine.

sa: विरथं तं समालोक्य हताश्वं हतसारथिम्। महता शरवर्षेण च्छादयामास संयुगे॥
en: Beholding him deprived of his car in consequence of its driver and steeds being slain, Somadatta's son covered him in the battle with a thick shower of arrows.

sa: नातिवृद्धमबालं च न कृशं न च पीवरम्। लघुवृत्तायतप्रायं सारयोधमनामयम्॥
en: Thus are neither very old nor very young; they are neither lean nor very corpulent. They are of active habits, well-built, strong bodied, and free from any disease.

sa: कच्चित्स कदनं कृत्वा परेषां कुरुनन्दन॥ स्वर्गतोऽभिमुख: संख्ये युध्यमानो नरर्षभैः।
en: "O delighter of the Kurus, spreading a terrible, slaughter among the enemy's host, did my son ascend to heaven having fought with many foremost of men in battle?

sa: ततः संगम्य पुत्रेण प्रीतिमानभवनृपः। ईजे च क्रतुभिः पुण्यैः समाप्तवरदक्षिणैः॥
en: Then king Srinjaya once more obtaining the sight of his son became highly delighted. He then gave away numerous merit-giving sacrificial gifts upon their accomplishment of the yajnas.

sa: द्रोणपुत्रो महेष्वासः सर्वानेवाति धन्विनः। समरे चित्रयोधी च दृढास्त्रश्च महारथः॥
en: That mighty bowman, the son of Drona (Ashvathama) surpasses all bowmen and is familiar with diverse modes of warfare and is of firm weapons; he is a Maharatha.

sa: अतिविद्धाश्च नाराचैर्वमन्तो रुधिरं मुखैः। सारोहा न्यपतन् भूमौ दुमवन्त इवाचलाः॥
en: Deeply pierced with Narachas and vomitting blood through the mouth, elephants with their riders, began to fall down on the ground like so many mountains covered with trees.

sa: नारद उवाच रामो महातपाः शूरो वीरलोकनमस्कृतः। जामदग्नयोऽष्यतियशा अवितृप्तो मरिष्यति॥
en: Narada said Even the heroic Rama that illustrious ascetic adored by the heroes of the world, that son of Jamadagni, of great renown, died with his desires unsatiated.

sa: विमर्दः सुमहानासीत् तस्य सैन्यस्य मारिष। रक्षसा घोररूपेण वध्यमानस्य संयुगे।॥
en: Great was the carnage that produced, O sire, in the ranks of the enemy., when they were assigned and slaughtered by the Rakshasas of fearful of fearful aspect.

sa: अथापरेण भल्लेन धनुश्चिच्छेद मारिष। सारथिं चास्य समरे क्षिप्रहस्तो न्यपातयत्॥
en: Then, O Bharata, with a broad-headed shaft the former severed the latter's bow; as also with great lightness of hand he overthrew with another broad-headed the latter's charioteer.

sa: सा जवलन्ती महोल्केव तमासाद्य महारथम्। सविस्फुलिङ्गा निर्भिद्य निपपात महीतले॥
en: Having reached that mighty car-warriors Arjuna, that lance blazing like a mighty meteor and emitting scintillations of fore, penetrated through him and then fell down on the ground.

sa: न बुद्धिभेदं जनयेदज्ञानां कर्मसङ्गिनाम्। जोषयेत् सर्वकर्माणि विद्वान् युक्तः समाचरन्।॥
en: a wise man should not confuse the mind of the ignorant who are attached to actions. He should make them take to actions, by himself acting without attachments.

sa: चित्रसेनो विकर्णश्च सैन्धवोऽथ बृहद्बलः। आवन्त्यौ च महेष्वासौ कौरवं पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Chitrasena, Vikarna, the ruler of the Sindhus, Brihadbala and the two Avanti princes, both great bow-men, all in a body surrounded the Kuru ruler (for the aiding him).

sa: एष पाण्डुसुतस्तात श्वेताश्वः कृष्णसारथिः। दहते मामकान् सर्वान् कृष्णवर्मेव काननम्॥
en: Duryodhana said "Yonder stands the son of Pandu, owing cream-coloured steeds and Krishna himself for his charioteer, consuming my ranks, O sire, like fire itself consuming a forest.

sa: अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते। तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम्॥
en: I give new gifts to those men, and preserve those that have been already acquired, who worship Me, mediating on Me and who are constantly devoted to Me.

sa: तस्योपविष्टस्य सतो विश्रान्तस्योपशृण्वतः। पुनरेव कथां चक्रुः कन्यां प्रति वनौकसः॥
en: Then did those dwellers of the forest again address that lady in the hearing of that sage after he had taken his seat and rested himself a little.

sa: संजय उवाच उपातिष्ठन्नथो वैद्याः शल्योद्धरणकोविदाः॥ सर्वोपरकरणैर्युक्ताः कुशलैः साधु शिक्षिताः।
en: Sanjaya said Thereafter there came several practitioners of the healing are, all well-trained and skillful in drawing out shafts, carrying with them all the necessary balms and appliances.

sa: तदङ्गपतिना गुप्तं कृपेण च मनस्विना। शारदाम्बुधरप्रख्यं प्राच्यानां सुमहद् बलम्॥
en: The large force of the people of the east which looked like the fleecy clouds of autumn was protected by the Anga prince and the greatly powerful Kripa.

sa: एवमाश्वासितः पार्थः कृष्णेनाद्भुतकर्मणा। ततोऽव्रबीत् तदा भ्रातृन् सर्वान् पार्थः सगद्गदान्॥
en: Thus consoled by Krishna of wonderful deeds, the son of Pritha (Arjuna) said to all his brothers these words in a voice choked with griefस दीर्घबाहुः पृथ्वंसो दीर्घराजीवलोचनः।

sa: अर्जुनश्चापि तं देवं भूयो भूयोऽप्यवन्दता ज्ञात्वा तं सर्वभूतादि भूतभव्यभवोद्भवम्॥
en: Arjuna also worshipped that Deity over and over again, knowing him to be origin of all creatures and the cause of the Past, the Present and the Future.

sa: ततो भीष्मो महाबाहुर्विनद्य जलदो यथा। तालमात्रं धनुर्गृह्य शङ्खमभ्यद्रवद् रणे॥
en: The long armed Bhishma challenged in reciprocation with his voice thundering like clouds, picked up a bow measuring four hands length and attacked on Shankha in the battlefield.

sa: बलवीर्यसमाविष्टः ससहायश्च साम्प्रतम्। नैष शक्यो युधा जेतुमपि वज्रभृता स्वयम्॥
en: At present he is surcharged with strength and prowess and is well supported. He is now incapable of being defeated even by the wielder of the thunderbolt himself.

sa: ये चान्ये सर्पसत्रज्ञा भविष्यन्त्यस्य चविजः। तांश्च सर्वान्दशिष्यामः कृतमेवं भविष्यति॥
en: We shall also bite those who are acquainted with the Snakes-sacrifice and who may be appointed as the Ritviks of the sacrifice. Thus we shall obtain our object."

sa: आरात् तिष्ठत मा मह्यं समीपमुपसर्पत।। कस्मान्मां नाभिजानीत प्राप्तं भागीरथीजलम्॥
en: Know me to be the Gandharva, named Angarparna who depends only on his own strength of arms. I am proud and haughty; I am the friend of Kubera.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तदा नागो वासुकि प्रत्यभाषत। यदि नागेन्द्र तुष्टोऽसि किमस्य धनसंचयैः॥
en: Having been thus addressed, the Naga (Arka) thus replied to Vasuki, “O king of the snakes, when you are pleased with him, he required no amassing of wealth.

sa: सोऽभिवाद्य ततः पादौ वाल्मीकेः पुरुषर्षभः। पाद्यमयं तथातिथ्यं जग्राह मुनिहस्ततः॥
en: And having bowed to the feet of the leading Muni, that foremost of men took from his hands water to wash feet and Arghya and accepted his hospitality.

sa: विनिश्चित्य स धर्मज्ञो ब्राह्मणैर्वेदपारगैः। अनुजज्ञे तदा ज्येष्ठामम्बां काशिपतेः सुताम्॥
en: The greatly virtuous man, after consulting with the Brahmanas, learned in the Vedas, allowed the eldest daughter of the king of Kashi, Amba, to do what she liked.

sa: यमनायं मतिं चक्रे पितुर्दर्शनलालसः। धर्मराजमथामन्त्र्य पृथां च पृथुलोचनः॥ ववन्दे चरणौ मूर्धा जगद्वन्द्यः पितृष्वसुः। स तया मूर्युपाघ्रात: परिष्वक्तश्च केशवः॥
en: The receiver of the worship of all the world, the possessor of large eyes, Keshava (Krishna) being desirous of seeing his father, made up his mind to go to (Dwarka). He saluted both Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira) and Pritha and bowed down to his aunt with his head touching her feet. She smelt his head and embraced him.

sa: धर्मराज उवाच प्रमद्वरां रुरोर्भार्यां देवदूत यदीच्छसि। उत्तिष्ठत्वायुषोऽर्धेन रुरोरेव समन्विता॥
en: The Dharmaraja said : "O messenger of heaven, if it be your wish, let the bride of Ruru Pramadvara, rise up endued with a half of Ruru's life.

sa: सीता हि विमला साध्वी तव पूर्वपरायणा। नागलोकं सुखं प्रायात्त्वदाश्रयतपोबलात्॥
en: By nature, Sītā is pure, chaste and ever dependent upon you. And by virtue of her ascetic dependence upon you she has gone to the region of Nagas.

sa: तस्य धर्मात्मनः पुत्रः समृद्धबलवाहनः। विश्वामित्र इति ख्यातो बभूव रिपुमर्दनः॥
en: His son was know by the name of Vishvamitra. That chastiser of foes, Vishvamitra, was virtuous-minded; and he had a large army of troop and beasts of burdens.

sa: उच्चैःश्रवाः सोऽश्वराजो यन्मिथ्या न कृतो मम। विनतार्थाय पणिते दासभावाय पुत्रकाः॥ जनमेजयस्य वो यज्ञे धक्ष्यत्यनिलसारथिः। तत्र पञ्चत्वमापन्नाः प्रेतलोकं गमिष्यथ॥
en: Addressing her sons she said, “As you have refused to to change the colour of Uchchaishrava, the king of horses, thus making me a slave to Vinata according to the wager, the god of fire will consume you all in the sacrifice of Janamejaya. Thus being killed, you will go to the land of the dead.

sa: श्रुत्वा सुहृद्वचस्तच्च जाश्चाप्यात्मनः क्षमम्। पुनः पुनर्मनो दधे राजसूयाय भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, having heard these words of his friends and having known his own strength also, the king again thought in his mind about the Rajasuya.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच भगवच्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि पूरोर्वंशकरान् नृपान्। यद्वीर्यान् यादृशांश्चापि यावतो यत्पराक्रमान्॥
en: Janamejaya said : Adorable Sir, I desire to hear the history of those kings who were descended from Puru. Tell me what powers and what achievements each possessed?

sa: आचार्यः कलशाज्जातो द्रोणः शस्त्रभृतां वरः। गौतमस्यान्ववाये च शरस्तम्बाच्च गौतमः॥
en: The foremost of all wielders of arms, the preceptor (Drona), was born in a water vessel and the son of Gautama (Kripa) sprung from a clump of heath.

sa: पौरा ऊचुः दुर्योधनप्रयुक्तेन पापेनाकृतबुद्धिना। गृहमात्मविनाशाय कारितं दाहितं च तत्॥ अहो धिग् धृतराष्ट्रस्य बुद्धिर्नातिसमञ्जसा। यः शुचीन् पाण्डुदायादान् दाहयामास शत्रुवत्॥
en: The Citizens said : The wicked minded (Purochana) built this house to destroy the relatives of his employer under the instructions of the Duryodhana and he has (now) set fire to it. Fire Fire on SO Dhritarashtra, whose understanding is partial! He has burnt to death the heirs of Pandu, as if they were his enemies?

sa: उत्पपात महावीर्यः पक्षिराट् परवीरहा। समुत्पत्यान्तरिक्षस्थं देवानामुपरिस्थितम्॥ वर्मिणो विबुधाः सर्वे नानाशस्त्रैरवाकिरन्। पट्टिशैः परिषैः शूलैर्गदाभिश्च सवासवाः॥ क्षुरप्रैचलितैश्चापि चक्रैरादित्यरूपिभिः। नानाशास्त्रविसर्गस्तैर्वध्यमानः समन्ततः॥
en: The greatly powerful king of birds, the slayer of enemies, rose on his wings and stayed in the sky over the heads of the celestials, with their lord Indra, who showered on him double edged swords, iron maces, sharp lances, bright arrows and discus of the form of the sun. Being thus attacked from every side,

sa: ऋक्षाश्च मृगमन्दायाः सृमराश्च परंतप। ततस्त्वैरावतं नागं जज्ञे भद्रमनाः सुतम्॥
en: O chastiser of foes, the offspring of Mrigamada are all beasts of bear species and also of those beasts, called Srimara. Bhadramana gave birth to her son Airavata.

sa: हिडिम्बोवाच नावमन्ये नरव्याघ्र त्वामहं देवरूपिणम्। दृष्टप्रभावस्तु मया मानुषेष्वेव राक्षसः॥
en: Hidimba said: O best of men, you are like a celestial. I do not consider you weak. but I have seen the prowess that Rakshasas exert on men.

sa: तां चेदहं न दित्सेयं त्वहगुणैरुपबृंहिताम्। प्रमथ्यैनां हरेयुस्ते हविर्खाङ्क्षा इवाध्वरात्॥
en: If I do not bestow this girl, endued with all qualities and possessing your blood, they may take her away by force as cows take the sacrificial ghee.

sa: वर्तमाने समाजे तु रमणीयेऽछि घोडशे। आप्लुताङ्गी सुवसना सर्वाभरणभूषिता॥ मालां च समुपादाय काञ्चनीं समलंकृताम्। अवतीर्णा ततो रङ्गं द्रौपदी भरतर्षभ॥
en: When this grand assembly continued (for 15 days,) then on the sixteenth day, O best of the Bharata race, Draupadi, having bathed, attired in the best robes and adorned with all ornaments entered the arena carrying in her hand a golden dish on which there were a garland of flowers and other offerings of the Arghya.

sa: यो जानाति परप्रज्ञा नीतिशास्त्रानुसारिणीम्। विज्ञायेह तथा कुर्यादापदं निस्तरेद् यथा॥
en: He who knows the schemes of others (enemies) according to the dictates of political science, knowing it, should act in such a way as to avoid all dangers.

sa: सर्वेषां देहहीनानां महद्दुःखं भविष्यति। लुप्यन्ते सर्वकार्याणि हीनदेहस्य वै प्रभो॥
en: O lord, the state of being bodiless is highly painful to all. The bodiless cannot perform any work; do you, therefore, by the favour, grant me another body.

sa: स राजा सिंहविक्रान्तो युवा विषयगोचरः। अविरोधेन धर्मस्य चचार सुखमुत्तमम्॥
en: That king was as powerful as the lion. He was young and enjoyed all the pleasures of life. He enjoyed unlimited happiness without violating the precepts of religion.

sa: तथेत्युवाच तं याजो राज्ञः प्रियचिकीर्षया। तयोश्च नामनी चक्रुद्धिजाः सम्पूर्णमानसाः॥
en: Desiring to do good to the king (Drupada) Yaja said, “Be it so." Thereupon the Brahmanas whose wishes were completely gratified (by present) gave these two (children) names.

sa: सोऽश्वान्विचारयित्वा तु रथे युक्तान्मनोजवान् ।।२१ आरोहस्वेति वैदेहीं सूतः प्राञ्जलिरब्रवीत्।
en: Thereupon Sumantra yoked the horses, gifted with the fleet course of the mind, to the chariot and with folded hands said to Sītā “Do you ascend the car."

sa: एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। विदुरं विदुषां श्रेष्ठं ज्ञातमित्येव पाण्डवः॥
en: Having been thus addressed, the king of virtue, the son of Pandu, Yudhishthira, thus replied to that foremost of learned men, the illustrious Vidura. "I have understood you."

sa: हर्षाविष्टांस्ततश्चैतान् नेयं सेहे वसुंधरा। भयापहो राजपुत्रः पाञ्चालानां यशस्करः॥ राज्ञः शोकापहो जात एष द्रोणवधाय वै। इत्युवाच महद् भूतमदृश्यं खेचरं तदा॥
en: The very earth appeared to be unable to bear the weight of the madly joyous Panchalas. “The price has been born for the destruction of Drona. He will dispel all the fears of the Panchalas and spread their fame. He will also remove the grief of the king.” Thus said the greatly wonderful voice of the sky managing beings.

sa: एष रुद्र महादेवं त्रिपुरान्तकरं हरम्। सर्वलोकेष्वतिबलः साक्षाद् द्रक्ष्यति मागधः॥
en: This Magadha prince, this mightiest of all mighty men in the world, will see with his physical eyes the god of gods, Rudra, the slayer of Tripura, Hara.”

sa: कच्चिदन्धश्च मूकांश्च पडून् व्यङ्गानबान्धवान्। पितेव पासि धर्मज्ञ तथा प्रव्रजितानपि॥
en: O (hero), learned in all virtuous precepts, do you cherish like a father the blind, the dumb, the lame, the deformed, the friendless, and also the homeless ascetics?

sa: अस्मानयमतिक्रम्य तृणीकृत्य च संगतान्। दातुमिच्छति विप्राय द्रौपदी योषितां वराम्॥
en: The kings said : Passing us by and regarding the assembled potentates as straw, this Draupada desires to bestow his daughter, the best of women, on a Brahmana.

sa: इतिहासः प्रधानार्थः श्रेष्ठः सर्वागमेष्वयम्। अनाश्रित्येदमाख्यानं कथा भुवि न विद्यते॥
en: So is it the best among all histories and also among all Shastras. There is not a story current in the world which does not depend on it.

sa: स प्रविष्टः पुरी रम्यां श्रीमानिक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः। प्रविवेश महाबाहुर्यत्र रामो महाद्युतिः।७।।
en: There upon having entered the highly picturesque city Ayodhyā, city Ayodhyā, the graceful descendant of Ikşvākus, ſatrughna, reached where the long-armed and the highly effulgent Råma was waiting.

sa: ततस्त्वजजनत् कृष्णा नक्षत्रे वह्निदैवते। सहदेवात् सुतं तस्माच्छ्रुतसेनेति यं विदुः॥
en: And because the son, Draupadi bore to Sahadeva, was born under the constellation, called Vahni Daivata, therefore he was called after the commander-in-chief of the celestials ariny, Shrutasena.

sa: सुखः शीतः सुगन्धी च पुष्परेणुवहोऽनिलः। परिक्रामन् वने वृक्षानुपैतीव रिरंसया॥
en: Pleasant, cool and fragrant breezes, mixed with the effluvia of sweet flowers, blew every where and appeared as if they had come there to play with the trees.

sa: द्रोण उवाच वारयैतौ महावीरों कृतयोग्यावुभावपि। मा भूद् रङ्गप्रकोपोऽयं भीमदुर्योधनोद्भवः॥
en: Drona said: “Ştop these two mighty heroes, so expert in arms. Let not the anger of the assembled people be excited by this encounter between Bhima and Duryodhana.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच शतं शतसहस्रं तु सर्वमक्षय्यवाचकम्। परिमाणं शतं वेतन्त्रेदमक्षय्यवाचकम्॥
en: The Brahmana said: The words "hundreds" and "hundred thousands” all indicate cternity. The "hundred" used by me should be understood as a limited period and not as eternity.

sa: तथा देवर्षयः सर्वे पार्थ शक्रमुपासते। अमला धूतपाप्मानो दीप्यमाना इवाग्नयः॥
en: O son of Pritha, there wait upon Shakra (Indra) all the celestials Rishis of pure soul, all as the fire, and all whose sins are completely washed off,

sa: संप्राप्तिश्चक्रधनुषोः खाण्डवस्य च दाहनम्। मयस्य मोक्षो ज्वलनाद्भुजङ्गस्य च मोक्षणम्।।
en: The acquisition by them the celebrated bow Gandiva and the discus; the burning of the forest of Khandava; the saving of the life of Maya and the serpent;

sa: ददृशुर्दारुणं रक्षो हिडिम्बं वननिर्झरे। हत्वा च तं राक्षसेन्द्रं भीताः समवबोधनात्॥ निशि संप्राद्रवन्पार्था धार्तराष्ट्रभयार्दिताः। प्राप्ता हिडिम्बा भीमेन यत्र जातो घटोत्कचः॥
en: They saw, near a fountain in the forest, a fearful Rakshasa named Hidimba. They killed that king of Rakshasas. They, the sons of Pritha, afraid of the sons of Dhritarashtra, then fled in the darkness, so that they might not run the risk of being seen by any body. Here did Bhima acquire Hidimba of whom Ghatotkacha was born.

sa: कथं ज्येष्ठानतिक्रम्य कनीयान् राज्यमर्हति। एतत् सम्बोधयामस्त्वां धर्मं त्वं प्रतिपालय॥
en: How it would be proper to pass over all the elders and install 1 the youngest? We represent this to you, act according to the precepts of religion.

sa: अथैनामष्टमे पुत्रे जाते प्रहसतीमिव। उवाच राजा दुःखार्तः परीप्सन् पुत्रमात्मनः॥
en: When the eighth son was born and when Ganga was smiling (before she threw it into the river), the king, desiring to protect his son, said in sorrow-

sa: तमुवाच महातेजाः कुम्भयोनिर्महातपाः। स्वागतं ते नरश्रेष्ठ दिष्ट्या प्राप्तोऽसि राघव।।२५
en: Thereupon the highly effulgent and leading ascetic Kumbhayoni said: O Rāghava, I have been greatly delighted with your coming, By my good fortune I have seen the today.

sa: ततस्तमजितं जेतुं जरासंधं वृकोदरः। संरम्भं बलिनां श्रेष्ठो जग्राह कुरुनन्दनः॥
en: That foremost of all strong men, that descendant of Kuru, Vrikodara (Bhima), mustered all his strength and courage with the desire of now vanquishing the hitherto unvanquished Jarasandha.

sa: एवं तेषामहं सम्यक् शप्तानां राजसत्तम। मोक्षार्थं मानुषाल्लोकाद् यथावत् कृतवत्यहम्॥
en: O best of kings, I did act accordingly. (I threw them into the waters) in order to free them from their earthly life, the effect of that curse.

sa: मत्तबहिणसंघुष्टं प्रविवेश महद् वनम्। तत् स चैत्ररथप्रख्यं समुपेत्य नरर्षभः॥
en: The best of men then entered that hermitage, which was resounding with the notes of the intoxicated pea-cocks and which appeared like the gardens of Chitraratha of Kubera.

sa: सा तु दृष्ट्वैव पितरमभिवाद्याग्रतः स्थिता। अनन्तरं ययातिस्तु पूजयामास भार्गवम्॥
en: Seeing her father, she made to him due salutation and stood before him. Yayati also came immediately after her and he saluted and worshipped the son of Bhrigu.

sa: निखिलेन यथातत्त्वं सौते सर्वमशेषतः। आस्तीकश्च द्विजश्रेष्ठः किमर्थं जयतां वरः॥
en: O Sauti, tell us in full the true story. Why did the best of the twice-born Astika, the foremost of ascetics, rescue the snakes from the blazing fire?

sa: स संस्कृत्य नरश्रेष्ठं मातुलं शौरिमात्मनः। ददर्श यदुवीराणामापाने वैशसं महत्॥
en: Performing the funeral ceremony of his maternal uncle Vasudeva, the foremost man of the Yadu dynasty, he saw the Yadu heroes lying dead where they had been drinking.

sa: भगवन्साधु पश्येस्त्वं देवतामिव खाच्च्युताम्। नद्यास्तु तीरे भगवन्वरस्त्री कापि दुःखिता॥
en: It is better that you should see her once. That beautiful damsel, like a goddess failing from heaven being bewildered, is waiting on the banks of the river.

sa: वरप्रदानं भा च कदूविनतयोस्तथा। नामनी चैव ते प्रोक्ते पक्षिणोर्वैनतेययोः॥
en: You have told us the bestowal of boons on Kadru and Vinata by their husband; you have also told us the names of the two sons of Vinata.

sa: श्रान्तयुग्यः श्रान्तहयो मृगलिप्सुः पिपासितः। स नाहुषः प्रेक्षमाण उदपानं गतोदकम्॥
en: The pair of horses in his car were fatigued and he himself was thirsty. That son of Nahusha (Yayati) saw a well in which there was no water.

sa: आससाद दुराधर्षः सैन्धवं सत्यविक्रमः। तं कर्णः संयुगे राजन् प्रत्यवारयदाशुगैः॥
en: And indomitable Dhananjaya, of prowess incapable of being baffled, came upon the ruler of the Sindhus. Karna however, O king, with his arrows, resisted him in that battle.

sa: वध्यमाने बले तस्मिन् सूतपुत्रेण मारिष। नकुलोऽभ्यद्रवत तूर्ण सूतपुत्रं महारणे॥
en: O father, while that immense force was being killed by the son of Suta, Nakula proceeded against that mighty car-warrior, the son of the Suta with great rapidity.

sa: रथै रथा विनिहता हस्तिभिश्चापि हस्तिनः। नरैर्नरा हताः पेतुरश्वश्चाश्वैः सहस्रशः॥
en: Cars, being destroyed by cars and elephants, smitten down by elephants, smitten down by elephants and men, slaughtered by men and horses, fell (upon the earth) in thousands.

sa: सैन्धवे रक्ष्यमाणे तु सूर्यस्यास्तमनं प्रति। मिथ्याप्रतिज्ञः कौन्तेयः प्रवेक्ष्यति हुताशनम्॥
en: If the ruler of the Sindhus can be saved till the sun sets, then the son of Kunti, in consequence of his vow being baffled will fall upon.

sa: यन्तारमब्रवीद् राजा भीमं प्रति नयस्व माम्। धर्मराजवचः श्रुत्वा सारथिर्हयकोविदः॥
en: Thus spoke to his charioteer-"Take me to the spot where Bhima is.” Hearing the words of the virtuous king Yudhishthira, the charioteer versed in the art of horse-driving.

sa: संजय उवाच पुत्रस्तव महाराज मद्रराजं महारथम्। विनयेनोपसंगम्य प्रणयाद् वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Sanjaya said O great king, your son, approaching the prince of Madras, that very powerful carwarrior, with enough of humility, spoke these words to him out of affection.

sa: तांस्तथाभिमुखान् वीरान् मित्रार्थे त्यक्तजीवितान्। क्षयं नयति राधेयः पञ्चालाञ्छतशो रणे॥
en: Rallying round the banner of their allies as these valiant Panchalas, reckless of their life, marched against him the son of Radha took off their hordes by legions.

sa: कर्णमाश्चित्य संग्रामे मन्दो दुर्योधनः पुनः। जेतुमुत्सहते पार्थान् सपुत्रान् सहकेशवान्॥
en: Relying upon Karna, the foolish prince Duryodhana, again, aspired to defeat the sons, of Pritha along with their sons, as well as Keshava in the field of battle.

sa: सूर्ये चक्षुः समाधाय प्रसन्नं सलिले मनः। ध्यायन् महोपनिषदं योगयुक्तोऽभवन्मुनिः॥
en: Steadying his eyes on the sun, setting his mind on the purified water and meditating the Mantras contained in the Upanishads, Bhurisravas betaking himself to yoga, became reticent.

sa: द्वाभ्यां जातो हि मातृभ्यामर्धदेहः पृथक् पृथक्। जरया संधितो यस्माजरासंधस्ततोऽभवत्॥
en: From two mothers, the two halves of his body come out separately. And in consequence of those two halves being united by that Rakshasi, he was called Jarasandha.

sa: विध्वस्ता हि रणे पार्थ सेनेयं भीमविक्रम॥ सेना शक्रस्येव पराक्रमैः।
en: O Partha, as the Asura hosts were routed by the prowess of Sakra in days of yore, so yonder host of terrible prowess have been vanquished by you.

sa: निन्द्यमानौ तथा कृष्णौ नोचतुः किंचिदप्रियम्। ततः प्रशस्यमानश्च नाहृष्यद् यूपकेतनः॥
en: Though thus reproached by the general voice, the two Krishnas uttered not a single word, nor did the stake-bannered Bhurisravas feel any joy in consequence of those encomiums.

sa: भवत्यवस्थिते यत्ते पाण्डवा मन्दचेतसः। द्रविष्यन्ति सहामात्याः पञ्चालाः सुंजयाश्च ह॥
en: When you will stay in the field, all those Pandavas of wicked soul with their allies, the Panchalas and the Srinjayas, all will run away from the field.

sa: अवाङ्मुखाः शस्त्रभृतः सर्व अप्रेक्षमाणाःशोकार्ता नाभ्यभाषन् परस्परम्॥ एव विशाम्पते। तु
en: And O king, all those who were armed with the weapons, stood speechless; and highly oppressed with grief, they neither beheld nor spoke any words to one another.

sa: पतङ्गवृत्तिमास्थाय फाल्गुनं योद्भुमिच्छति॥ यावन्नः पश्यमानानां प्राणान् पार्थेन संगतः। । न जह्यात् पुरुषव्याघ्रस्तावद् वारय कौरवम्॥ यावत् फाल्गुनबाणानां गोचरं नाद्य गच्छति।
en: Resorting to the practices of the insects, (which heedless of danger rush into fire) is desiring to fight with Arjuna (heedless of his life). Prevent the Kaurava king (from doing this) before he sacrifices his life in our very sight by encountering Partha in battle. So long as he does not present himself within the range। of Kirit's shafts.

sa: तत्राक्रन्दो महानासीत् पाण्डवानां विशाम्पते। दृष्ट्वा सेनापति यान्तं पञ्चालानां रथव्रजान्॥
en: On seeing the commander of the (Kaurava) army rushing against the car-warriors of the Panchala force, there arose a dreadful uproar against the Pandavas, O ruler of earth.

sa: मृत्योर्मुखगतं मन्ये कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्। हुतमग्नौ च कौन्तेयं दुर्योधनवशं गतम्॥
en: I regard Kunti's son Yudhishthira who has been brought under the influence of Duryodhana as within the mouth of Death or like an oblation of ghee in fire.

sa: तस्मिन् निपतिते भूमौ विह्वले राजसत्तमे॥ आर्तनादो महानासीत् स्त्रीणां भरतसत्तम।
en: O the most excellent of the Bharata race, on the fall of the highly agitated and foremost of monarchs upon the ground, there was tremendous wailing of women.

sa: विरथावसियुद्धाय समेयातां महारणे। आर्षभे चर्मणी चित्रे प्रगृह्य विपुले शुभे॥
en: And thus deprived of the use of their cars, encountered each other for sword fighting. Taking up two large and beautiful and variegated shields made of bull's hide.

sa: इति ब्रुवन्तो वेगेन निपेतुस्ते महारथाः। वयं प्रतिजिगीषन्तस्तत्र तान् समभिद्रुताः॥
en: Thus speaking, the mighty car-warriors of the Pandavas impetuously dashed against us. Indeed they then feel upon us exclaiming "we will conquer those who will rush against ourselves."

sa: ततोऽस्य छेत्तुपारब्धः शिरः कायात् सकुण्डलम्। तावत्क्षणात् सात्वतोऽपि शिरः सम्भ्रमयंस्त्वरन्॥
en: Bhurisravas was then about to sever from Satyaki's trunk his head graced with earrings. For sometimes, that hero of the Satvata race rapidly whirling round with the rod.

sa: रन्ये च योधास्त्वरितास्त्वदीयाः। कृत्वा मुखं भारत योधमुख्यं दुःशासनं त्वत्सुतमाजमीढ॥
en: Then, O descendant of Ajamidas race, yours sons, united with other soldiers of your army, quickly rushed against Satyaki, making that foremost of warrior's viz., Dushasana their leader.

sa: रथशब्दधनुः शब्दैर्नादयन्त दिशो दश। नर्दन्तमिव शार्दूलं दृष्ट्वा क्रोष्टा भविष्यसि॥
en: Beholding the ten quarters filled with the sound of his car and the twang of his bow and him roaring like a tiger you will become a jackal.

sa: भवेत् सत्यमवक्तव्यं न वक्तव्यमनुष्ठितम्। सत्यानृते विनिश्चित्य ततो भवति धर्मवित्॥
en: Indeed it is not a very easy thing to become righteous. He who can distinguish between the niceties of truth and untruth can alone become conversant with morality.

sa: ततस्ताः संजयो राजन् समाश्वासयदातुराः। मुह्यमानाः सुबहुशो मुञ्चन्त्यो वारि नेत्रजम्॥
en: Thereupon, O monarch, Sanjaya consoled those ladies, who were highly oppressed with sorrow and deprived of their senses and who, again, were copiously shedding tears from their eyes.

sa: द्रौणेस्तत् कर्म दृष्ट्वा तु सर्वभूतान्यपूजयन्। यदवप्लत्य जग्राह घोरां शङ्करनिर्मिताम्॥
en: Seeing the son of Drona achieve that (wonderful) feat all the creatures adored (him) inasmuch as leaping down from his car he seized that (Asani) made by Sankara.

sa: नैनं दुःशासनः सूतं नापि कश्चन सैनिकः। कृत्तोत्तमाङ्गमाशुत्वात् सहदेवेन बुद्धवान्॥
en: Owing to the quickness with which the charioteer's head was cut-off, neither any one among the troops nor Dushasana himself perceived him to have been decapitated by Sahadeva.

sa: हताश्वात् तु रथात् तूर्णमवप्लुत्य युधिष्ठिरः॥ तस्थावूलभुजो राजा व्यायुधो भरतर्षभ।
en: Then quickly jumping down from the chariot whose horses had been slain, Yudhishthira stood on the field, weaponless and with his arms upraised, O foremost of the Bharatas.

sa: माधवस्तु रणे विद्धो धर्मपुत्रेण मारिष। प्राकम्पत च रोषेण सप्तभिश्चादयच्छरैः॥
en: Pierced in (that) battle by the son of Dharma, O worshipful sire, the descendant of Madhu (i.e. Kritavarma) trembled in ire and (then) afflicted (Yudhishthira) with seven arrows.

sa: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम्। कुरूणां पाण्डवानां च परस्परजयैषिणाम्॥
en: Thereupon the formidable battle began, which caused the hair of the body stand erect, between the Kurus and the Pandavas, each party being desirous of vanquishing the other.

sa: संजय उवाच स बाहुय॑पतद् भमौ सखङ्ग सशुभाङ्गदः। आदधजीवलोकस्य दुःखमद्भुतमुत्तमः॥
en: Sanjaya said Then that arm with the sword in grasp and decked with beautiful Angadas, fell down on the earth, thereby inflicting great grief on the living creation.

sa: पराजयो वा मृत्युर्वा श्रेयान् मृत्युन निर्जयः। विजिताश्चारयो होते शस्रोत्सर्गान्मृतोपमाः॥
en: The worst in battle is either defeat or death. Death is better than defeat. The enemy compelled to lay aside their weapons are vanquished and more than dead.

sa: क्षुरप्रेण धनुश्छित्त्वा द्रौणिं विव्याध पत्रिणा। तदपास्य धनुश्छिन्नं द्रोणपुत्रो महामनाः॥
en: Cutting off the bow of Drona's son with a razor-headed arrows pierced him with a winged shaft. Thereupon the high-souled son of Drona, throwing off that severed bow.

sa: त्वं चापि न यथापूर्वं प्रकृतिस्थो नराधिप। कर्णप्रभृतयश्चेमे नावतिष्ठन्ति पार्थिव॥
en: Why, O king, do you not try to rally them when they are thus flying away? O ruler of men, you also are not in your usual mood.

sa: तान् निकृत्तानिषून् दृष्ट्वा दूरतो ब्रह्मवादिना॥ न्यवेदयत् केशवाय विस्मितः श्वेतवाहनः।
en: Beholding those shafts severed from a distance by that reciter of the Vedas (Ashvatthaman) the owner of the creamcoloured steeds (Arjuna), filled with surprise, addressing Keshava thus spoke

sa: सा तु बुद्धिः कृताप्येवं जाग्रति त्रिदशेश्वरे। अप्रमेये हृषीकेशे युद्धकालेऽप्यमुह्यत॥
en: We rose every morning with this resolution regarding that lord of the celestials, viz., Hrishikesha of infinite prowess. But at the time of battle we forgot our resolution.

sa: अथैनं रुक्मपुङ्खानां शतेन नतपर्वणाम्। आचिनोद वहुधा राजन भग्नदंष्ट्रमिव द्विपम्॥
en: He then, O great king, pierced him (i.e. Somadatta), who then looked like a snake with its fangs broken, with one hundred straightcoursing arrows furnished with golden wings.

sa: हतांश्चैव विषक्तांश्च पराभूतांश्च शंससि। रथिनो विरथांश्चैव कृतान् युद्धेषु मामकान्॥
en: son (You say) that, in the encounter. my soldiers were (either) killed, Driven away or defeated and that my car-warriors were deprived of their cars in the encounter.

sa: एतेऽर्जुनस्य क्रुद्धस्य कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम्। उद्युक्ता पृथिवी सर्वा ससुरासुरमानुषा॥
en: All these warriors, taken together, cannot equal the sixteenth part of Arjuna, when he becomes angry. The whole earta rising against him, with her gods, Asuras and men.

sa: जेतारो वृष्णिवीराणां किं पुनर्मानवा रणे। ब्रह्मद्रव्ये गुरुद्रव्ये ज्ञातिस्वे चाप्यहिंसकाः॥
en: Can conquer the Vrishni heroes, what to speak of men! They never cast covetousglances on the things of possessions of their kinsmen, preceptor or those of the Brahmanas.

sa: तमब्रवीद वासुदेवः किमिदं पाण्डुनन्दन। वार्यमाणोऽपि कौन्तेय यद् युद्धान्न निवर्तसे॥
en: Then the son of Vasudeva, addressing (Bhima) said-"O delighter of Pandu, what do you mean? Why don't you desist from fighting though repeatedly for bidden to do so.

sa: के पुरस्तादवर्तन्त निघ्नतः शात्रवान् रणे। मन्येऽहं पाण्डवान् सर्वान् भारद्वाजशरार्दितान्॥
en: Who were they that fought in, his van when he was destroying the enemies? I think that afflicted with the darts of the of Bharadvaja, all the Pandavas.

sa: आरुरोह रथं चापि सूतपुत्रप्रतापितः। निश्वसन् दुःखसंतप्तः कुम्थ्यस्थ इव पन्नगः॥
en: He then, being afflicted by the son of Suta, ascended the car (of his brother) and being oppressed with grief, sighed heavily like shake confided within a vessel.

sa: स श्रुत्वा निहतं कर्णं दुर्योधनहितैषिणम्। कथं द्विजवर प्राणानधारयत दुःखितः॥
en: Having heard of the death of Karna the benefactor of Duryodhana, how could he, O best of the regenerate persons, hold his life, much aggrieved as he was?

sa: यथा रात्रिक्षये राजन् ज्योतीष्यस्तागिरि प्रति। समापेतुस्तथा बाणा भीमसेनरथं प्रति॥
en: Just as at the close of night, all the luminaries fly towards the western hills, so also the shafts of Drona's son flew towards the car of Bhima.

sa: स विपन्नरथो भीमो नकुलस्याप्लुतो रथम्। हरिर्यथा गिरेः शृङ्गं समाक्रामदरिंदमः॥
en: When his chariot was thus rendered useless, hat subduer of foes, viz., Bhima, quickly jumped into the chariot of Nakula like a lion leaping upon a mountain chest.

sa: स भिन्नकवचः शूरस्तोत्रादित इव द्विपः। विमुच्य सशरं चायं भूरिव्रणपरिस्रवः॥
en: Then like an elephant afflicted with the goad-stroke, with his armour pierced through and shedding copious blood from the wound, that hero Satyaki left his bow and arrows.

sa: संजय उवाच युधिष्ठिरणैवमुक्तः कौन्तेयः श्वेतवाहनः। असिं जग्राह संक्रुद्धो जिघांसुर्भरतर्षभम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Hearing the words of Yudhishthira, Kownteya-the owner of white steeds-in a tempestuous mood took hold of his sword to slay that mightiest of the Bharata's race.

sa: संजय उवाच सोऽवतीर्य रथोपस्थादसम्भ्रान्तो धनंजयः। गाण्डीवं धनुरादाय तस्थो गिरिरिवाचलः॥
en: Sanjaya said Thereupon descending from the terrace of his car, Dhananjaya, with the Gandiva bow in his grasp, stood on the field of battle like an immovable hill.

sa: यः स्तेनैः सह सम्बन्धान्मुच्यते शपथैरपि॥ श्रेयस्तत्रानृतं वक्तुं तत् सत्यमविचारितम्।
en: There even, where one cuts off his connections with robbers after having taken an oath, it is better to swear falsely, for surely that falsehood would be truth.

sa: संजय उवाच वर्तमाने तदा रौद्रे रात्रियुद्धे विशाम्पते। सर्वभूतक्षयकरे धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥ अब्रवीत् पाण्डवांश्चैव पञ्चालांश्चैव सोमकान्। अभिद्रवत् संयातं द्रोणमेव जिघांसया॥
en: Sanjaya said When, O lord of the earth, that terrific nocturnal battle, destructive of all the creatures, was raging, Yudhishthira, the son of Dharma, spoke to the (other) Pandavas and the united Panchalas and Somakas, O monarch, for the destruction of men, cars and elephants, "make a rush upon Drona only in order to slay him."

sa: कुण्डली मुकुटी खड्गी रक्तचन्दनरूषितः। शिरसा धारयन् दीप्तां तपनीयमी स्रजम्॥
en: And graced with Kundalas and a diadem and armed with a sword and anointed with red sandal paste and wearing round his head an effulgent garland of gold.

sa: एष ह्यनर्थे सततं पराक्रान्तस्तवानघ। निकृत्या धर्मराजं च द्यूते वञ्चितवानयम्॥
en: O sinless one, this Duryodhana ever tried to bring down distress on you. Through deceitful measures, he defeated the very virtuous king Yudhishthira at the game of dice.

sa: तं प्रयान्तं महाबाहुं सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरम्। नाशक्नवन् वारयितुं योधाः क्रुद्धमिवान्तकम्॥
en: Then your warriors were unable to check that mighty-armed hero, that foremost of all wielders of weapons, viz., Arjuna, who had been proceeding like the enraged Destroyer himself.

sa: तथाश्वरथनागानां कृतं च कदनं महत्। सर्वमाख्यातवान् वीरो वासुदेवः किरीटिने॥
en: Then also a dreadful slaughter of the horses, cars and elephants was made (by that warrior). Thus the hero, Vasudeva, related all these to the diadem-decked one (Arjuna).

sa: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु दाशार्हो विकिरछरान्। धृष्टद्युम्नं पराक्रान्तं सात्यकिः प्रत्यपद्यत॥
en: 0 lord, the troops then considered Dhristadyumna to be already within the jaws of Death, as he was then confronted by the six foremost car-warriors of your army.

sa: श्रेणिमांश्च महाराज युध्यमानः पराक्रमी। कृत्वा नसुकरं कर्म गतो वैवस्वतक्षयम्॥
en: O great king, having achieved the most terrible tasks Srenimat, who was engaged in battle and possessed of mighty prowess, had gone to the abode of Death. were

sa: जरासंधो हि रुषितो रौहिणेयप्रधर्षितः। अस्मद्वधार्थं चिक्षेप गदां वै सर्वघातिनीम्॥
en: Once on a time, afflicted by the son of Rohini, Jarasandha, excited to the highest pitch of fury, hurled at ourselves a mace capable of slaying at creatures.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नं च विव्याध नवभिर्निशितैः शरैः। जीवितान्तकरैः क्रुद्धः क्रुद्धरूपं परंतपः॥
en: Then, O subduer of foes, filled with rage, he pierced the wrathful Dhristadyumna with nine sharp arrows capable of putting an end to the life of every body.

sa: अतिष्ठ युगमध्ये स युगसनहनेषु च। जधानार्थेषु चाश्वानां तत् सैन्यान्यभ्यपूजयन्॥
en: And sometimes beside the horses. His troops then applauded him highly. When he, armed with the sword, was thus moving quickly on the backs of those crimson steeds.

sa: सैन्धवं पर्यरक्षन्त शासनात् तनयस्य ते। ततः पार्थस्य शूरस्य बाह्वोर्बलमदृश्यत॥
en: They began to exert themselves for protecting the ruler of the Sindhus, at the command of your son. We then beheld the strength of the heroic Partha's arms.

sa: द्रोणस्तु परमक्रुद्धो वायव्यास्रेण पार्थिवम्। विव्याध सोऽपि तद् दिव्यमस्रमस्रेण जनिवान्॥
en: Drona also, exceedingly enraged, discharged at that Pandava the weapon presided over by Vayu. over by Vayu. But he (i.e., Yudhishthira) destroyed that celestial weapon with (another) weapon.

sa: तयोः सेनामतिक्राम्य कृच्छ्रादिव धनंजयः। विबभौ जलदं हित्वा दिवाकर इवोदितः॥
en: Then Dhananjaya, having passed with difficulty, through their (Vinda and Anuvinda's) divisions, appeared beautiful like the lustrous orb of the day emerging out of a cluster of clouds.

sa: तावन्योन्यं शरैर्भित्त्वा स्वर्णपुजैः शिलाशितैः। व्यभ्राजेतां यथा मेघौ संस्यूतौ सूर्यरश्मिभिः॥
en: Piercing each other with arrows furnished with golden wings and whetted on stone, those two heroes appeared beautiful like two clouds fringed with the rays of the sun.

sa: तस्य तेऽशोभयन् वक्त्रं कर्मारपरिमार्जिताः॥ प्रफुल्लं पङ्कजं यद्वद् भ्रमरा मधुर्लिप्सवः।
en: These shafts, polished by the black-smith, looked on the face of Dhristadyumna like so many black bees on a full blown lily desirous of sucking the sweet honey.

sa: पाणौ पृषत्का लिखिता ममैते धनुश्च दिव्यं विततं सबाणम्। पादौ च मे सरथौ सध्वजौ च न मादृशं युद्धगतं जयन्ति॥
en: My palms bear the marks of these arrows and this superb and out-stretched bow with its string trimmed with arrow; the soles of my feet also bear the marks of a car and a standard; and so when a person (with all these marks on) goes to battle, he, least of all, can be triumphed over."

sa: तत्राद्भुतं परं चक्रे कौन्तेयः कृष्णसारथिः॥ यदेको बहुभिः सार्धं समागच्छदभीतवत्।
en: Then that son of Kunti having Krishna for his charioteer, inspired his foes with wonder. Inasmuch as he, though single handed, dauntlessly encountered the numerous odds against him;

sa: त्वमुत्पन्नो महाबाहो पञ्चालानां वधं प्रति। करिष्यसि जगत् सर्वमपाञ्चालं किलोद्यतः॥
en: As, O mighty-armed one, you have sprung into existence in order to slay the Panchalas, you will surely, exerting your utmost, make the earth devoid of the Panchalas.

sa: प्रादुश्चक्रेऽस्रमैन्द्रं वै प्राजापत्यं च भारत। जिघांसुर्धर्ततनयं तव पुत्रहिते रतः॥
en: Devoted to the welfare of your son, called into existence the weapons presided over by Varuna or Prajapati, in order to slay the son of Dharma, O Bharata.

sa: मम लुब्धस्य पापस्य तथा धर्मापचायिनः। व्यायामेन जिगीषन्तः प्राप्ता वैवस्वतक्षयम्॥
en: Desirous of securing victory (for me who am covetous and sinful and a rebel against virtue, these (kings) have gone to the abode of the sons of Vivasvata.

sa: तं निहत्य रणे शूरः शैनेयो रथसत्तमः॥ युधामन्युरथं तूर्णमासरोह परंतपः।
en: That war-like grandson of Shini, that best of car-warriors, that scorcher of enemies, after having slain him (the Kaikeya chief) in battle, immediately ascended the car of Yudhamanyu.

sa: त्रिभिट्टैणोऽहरत् प्राणांस्ते हता न्यपतन् भुवि। ततो द्रोणोऽजयद् युद्धे चेदिकैकेयसंजयान्॥
en: Three in number Drona robbed the vital breaths, whereupon they fell down dead on the ground. Thereafter Drona vanquished in battle, the Chedis the Kaikayas and the Srinjayas.

sa: न प्रमत्ताय भीताय विरथाय प्रयाचते। व्यसने वर्तमानाय प्रहरन्ति मनस्विनः॥
en: The righteous never strike him who is careless or who is frightened or who is made carless or who implores mercy or who is involved in a calamity.

sa: स तैरभ्याहतो गाढं शरैर्भीमसुतेरितैः। चचाल रथमध्यस्थो वातोद्धत इव दुमः॥
en: Deeply wounded by those arrows sent by the son of Bhima, he (i.e., Ashvatthama), like a tree shaken by the tempest trembled on the terrace of his car.

sa: ववुर्वाताः सनिर्घाताः पांशुवर्षं पपात च। बभूवुश्च दिशः सर्वास्तिमिरेण समावृताः॥
en: Fierce winds began to blow with loud noises at intervals, and a shower of dust fell. All the points of the compass were covered with a thick darkness.

sa: दुष्टं पन्थानमासाद्य यो मोहादुपपद्यते। आत्मनो बलभज्ञाय तदन्तं तस्य जीवितम्॥
en: He, who, without knowing his own । strength, treads a wicked path and persists in wa'king along it, soon loses his very life as the result of it.

sa: यथेष्टं गम्यतां काममनुजाने प्रसाद्य वः॥ सर्वे मामनुजानीत तयक्ष्यामीदं कलेवरम्।
en: I humbly pray you to grant me permission in this and go wherever you please. Let every one grant me permission. I shall renounce this body of mine."

sa: यथा सैन्येन रजसा समुद्भूतेन वाहिनी। प्रत्यदृश्यत संछन्ना तथा बाणैर्महात्मनः॥
en: The Pandava army was then covered with the arrows of that great warriors even as a army is covered with the dust it raises while marching for battle.

sa: सुयोधन किमर्थोऽयमारम्भोऽप्सु कृतस्त्वया। सर्वं क्षत्रं घातयित्वा स्वकुलं च विशाम्पते॥
en: "Why, O Suyodhana, have you charined these waters, after having caused all the Kshatriyas to die and after having, O king, brought about the extinction of your family?

sa: ये चैव पुरुषाः स्त्रीभिर्गीतवाद्यैरुपस्थिताः। य चानाथाः परान्नादा: कालस्तेषु समक्रियः॥
en: Time acts impartially towards rich men who enjoy the pleasure of song and dance in the company of women and those unfortunate men who live upon another's food.

sa: तस्य शोणितदिग्धान् वै केशानुद्यम्य पाणिना। उत्सङ्गे वक्त्रमाधाय जीवन्तमिव पृच्छति॥ स्वतीयं वासुदेवस्य पुत्रं गाण्डीवधन्वनः। कथं त्वां रणमध्यस्थं जनुरेते महारथाः॥
en: See, O Krishna, collecting with her hands the blood-dyed hair of her husband and placing his head on her lap, beautiful lady is addressing him as if he were alive,-How could those great car-warriors kill you in the midst of battle,-you who are the sister's son of Vasudeva and the son of the bolder of Gandiva?

sa: नागायुतबलप्राणः स राजा भीममायसम्। भक्त्वा विमथितोरस्कः सुनाव रुधिरं मुखात्॥
en: Possessed of the strength of ten thousands elephants, the king broke that statue into pieces. His own breast, however, was considerably bruised and he began to vomit blood.

sa: द्वैपायनवचः श्रुत्वा शिनेर्नप्ता कृताञ्जलिः। ततो मामब्रवीन्मुक्त्वा स्वस्ति संजय साधय॥
en: Hearing these words of Vyasa, the grandson of Shini joined his hands and then setting me free, said to me-Peace to you, O Sanjaya, you may go away.

sa: तस्मिन् प्रवृत्ते सत्रे तु ब्रह्मणः पार्थिवर्षभ। दृष्ट्रपप्रधानत्वाद् दण्डः सोऽन्तर्हितोऽभवत्॥
en: Upon the commencement of that sacrifice, of Brahman, O best of kings, punishment disappeared on account of the visible form that the Grandfather was then obliged to assume.

sa: तयोस्तत्र शितैर्मुक्तैर्यमदण्डनिभैः शरैः। समाच्छन्ना धरा सर्वा खं दिशो विदिशस्तथा॥
en: With the sharp arrows, resembling the dreadful rod of Yama, shot by those two warriors, the earth, the sky and all the points of the horizon were covered.

sa: विषये वर्तमानानां यं ते वैशेषिकैर्गुणैः। प्राहुर्विषयगोप्तारं तस्मै गोप्वात्मने नमः॥
en: People according to the attributes assigned to you by the Vaisheshika theory, consider you as the Protector of the world. Salutations to you in your form of Protector.

sa: चषाले यस्य सौवर्णे तस्मिन् यूपे हिरण्मये। ननृतुर्देवगन्धर्वाः षट् सहस्राणि सप्तधा॥ अवादयत् तत्र वीणां मध्ये विश्वावसुः स्वयम्। सर्वभूतान्यमन्यन्त मम वादयतीत्ययम्॥
en: Upon that highly effulgent golden stake decked with a ring, six thousand gods and Gandharvas danced in joy, and Vishvavasu himself, in their midst played on his Vina the notes according to the rules of concordance. Such the nature of Vishvavasu's music that every creature, wherever he might be, thought that the great Gandharva was playing to him alone.

sa: हर्षयेयुर्विषण्णांश्च व्यवस्थाप्य परस्परम्। जितां च भूमि रक्षेत भग्नान् नात्यनुसारयेत्॥
en: Assuring one another, they should cheer up the cheerless. The victor should protect the newly conquered country. He should not cause his troops to pursue the dispersed enemies.

sa: ते खल्वपि कृतास्त्राश्च बलवन्तश्च भूमिपाः। आगम्य पर्युपासन्ते मामीशं सुखदुःखयोः॥
en: All of them were clever in weapons and all of them were powerful. Knowing me as the giver of happiness and misery, they approached me for offering adorations.

sa: षड्विधं दुर्गमास्थाय पुराण्यथ निवेशयेत्। सर्वसम्पत्प्रधानं यद् बाहुल्यं चापि सम्भवेत्॥
en: Keeping his eye on the six different sorts of forts the king should build his cities containing every kind of riches and every article of use in profusion.

sa: अरोगाः सर्वसिद्धार्था मनुष्या अकुतोभयाः। यथाभिकाममवसन् क्षेत्रेषु च गृहेषु च॥
en: All men enjoyed health and all their wishes were fructified. They had no fear of any kind. They used to live, as they pleased, in fields or houses.

sa: निवृत्ताः सहसा योधास्तव पुत्रजयैषिणः। सन्निवृत्तेषु तेष्वेवं युद्धमासीत् सुदारुणम्॥ तावकानां परेषां च देवासुररणोपमम्। परेषां तव सैन्ये वा नासीत् कश्चित् पराङ्मुखः॥
en: The Kuru warriors, seeking your son's welfare, suddenly came back. Upon their return, the battle once more became fearful, between your warriors and those of the foe, resembling that between the gods and the Asuras in the days of yore. Neither amongst the enemies nor amongst your people was there a single warrior who fled away from the field.

sa: तयोः संवदतोरेवं तथैवापन्नयोर्द्वयोः॥ क्षयं जगाम सा रात्रिर्लोमशं त्वाविशद् भयम्।
en: While the mouse and the cat were thus conversing, both in serious danger, the night gradually passed away. A great fear, however, possessed the heart of the cat.

sa: कर्माणि वैदिकान्यस्य स्वर्यः पन्थास्त्वनुत्तमः। अथ सर्वाणि कर्माणि मन्त्रसिद्धानि चक्षते॥
en: These Vedic rites constitute his heaven, path, and best of sacrifices, If it were Otherwise, how could the acts of persons seeking of heaven become successful through Mantras?

sa: तस्माद् गत्वा ऋषिश्रेष्ठो याच्यतां सुरसत्तमाः॥ दधीचास्थीनि देहीति तैर्वधिष्यामहे रिपून्।
en: O best of celestials, go, therefore, to that best of Rishis and beg of him, saying-"Grant us, O Dadhicha, your bones! With them we will kill our enemies.'

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच महानयं धर्मपथो बहुशाखश्च भारत। किंस्विदेवेह धर्माणामनुष्ठेयतमं मतम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said The path of duty in long. It has also, O Bharata, many branches. What are those duties which you hold to be the best to practise.

sa: अथात्मकृत्ये त्वरितः सम्यक् प्रश्रितमाचरन्। उवाच लोमशो वाक्यं मूषिकं चिरकारिणम्॥
en: Indeed, the cat, who had quickly and properly carried his own part of the agreement, addressing the mouse who was not quick enough in fulfilling his part, said,-

sa: अकाले कृत्यमारब्धं कर्तुर्नार्थाय कल्पते। तदेव काल आरब्धं महतेऽर्थाय कल्पते॥
en: When a work is begun at an improper time, it never becomes profitable when finished. That act, however, which is undertaken at the proper time, yields rich fruits.

sa: ततः शल्यो महाराज निर्विद्धस्तैर्महारथैः॥ सुस्राव रुधिरं गात्रैगैरिकं पर्वतो यथा।
en: Thus pierced, O king, by those mighty carwarriors, blood began to flow from Shalya's body, like red streams running down the breast of a mountain of red chalk.

sa: एतावच्छ्रेय इत्येव बृहस्पतिरभाषत। इन्द्रस्तु भूयः पप्रच्छ को विशेषो भवेदिति॥
en: Indeed, Brihaspati pointed out knowledge to be the source of supreme happiness. Indra, however, once more asked him as to whether there was any thing superior to that.

sa: प्रहादस्त्वब्रवीद् विप्रं क्षणो नास्ति द्विजर्षभ। त्रैलोक्यराज्यसक्तस्य ततो नोपदिशामि ते॥
en: Prahlada answered the Brahmana, saying,-O chief of the twice-born, I have no time, being wholly engaged with the task of ruling the three worlds!-I cannot therefore, instruct you.

sa: नीलचर्मावृतैः खड्नैर्बाहुभिः परिघोपमैः॥ यस्य वेदिरुपस्तीर्णा तस्य लोका यथा मम।
en: He, who covers the altar of the sacrifice formed by battle, with swords cased in bluescabbards and severed arms resembling heavy bludgeons, acquires the happy regions like mine.

sa: आदावेव मनुष्येण वर्तितव्यं यथाक्षमम्। यथा नातीतमर्थं वै पश्चात्तापेन युज्यते॥
en: Every one should, at the beginning follow such a line of action that he mey not have, in the end, to repent for something already done by him.

sa: मुक्तश्च व्यसनादस्मात् सौम्याहमपि नाम ते। प्रीतिमुत्पादयेयं च प्रीतिकर्तुश्च सक्रियाम्॥
en: O amiable one, freed from this danger, I shall surely try to please you, and adore and honour you on every occasion in return for your good offices.

sa: यस्य बाहुप्रतापेन तापिताः सर्वतो वयम्॥ तमग्निमिव वस्त्रेण कथं छादितवत्यसि।
en: The power of his arms scorched all of us! How, O mother, could you conceal him like a person concealing a fire within the folds of his cloth?

sa: तथैव कौरवो राजा धर्मपुत्रो महामनाः। कृपप्रभृतयश्चैव किमकुर्वत ते त्रयः॥
en: What also did the great Kuru king Yudhishthira the son of Dharma do? What did the three survivors (of the Kuru army, viz.,) Kripa and the others do?

sa: अथात्र नारायणगीतमार्छ महर्षयस्तात महानुभावाः। महार्थमत्यन्ततपःप्रयुक्तं तदुच्यमानं हि मया निबोध॥
en: Regarding it, the illustrious and great Rishis cite a verse sung by Narayana himself, highly important and endued with high ascetic merit. Hear me as I repeat it.

sa: त्रिवर्गो हि समासक्तो राजधर्मेषु कारैव। मोक्षधर्मश्च विस्पष्टः सकलोऽत्र समाहितः॥
en: O you of Kuru's race, Religion, Profit, and Pleasure depend on royal duties. It is also clear that the practices that lead to liberation equally depend on them.

sa: तत: संस्मृत्य तत् सर्वं स्मारयिष्यन्निवाब्रवीत्। राजानं भगवान् विप्रस्ततः कृशतनुस्तदा॥
en: Rishabha said Remembering all the past incidents and calling them back to the recollection of the king also, that holy Brahmana of emaciated body said to the king.

sa: स शोचत्पादं प्राप्य यथाहमतिवर्त्य तौ। शास्त्रदृष्टानविद्वान् यः समतीत्य जिघांसति॥
en: That fool who, disregarding the way laid down by the scriptures, tries to kill his enemies, falls off from the path of righteousness and is lost in sin.

sa: त्वं तु केवलमौर्येण विमूढो नावबुद्ध्यसे॥ पृथिवीं दातुकामोऽपि जीवितेन विमोक्ष्यसे।
en: Fool as you are, you do not see the impropriety of this! Although you wish to give away the Earth, you shall not yet escape me with life.

sa: स्वजातिगुणसम्पन्नाः स्वेषु कर्मसु संस्थिताः। प्रकर्तव्या ह्यमात्यास्तु नास्थाने प्रक्रिया क्षमा।॥
en: Ministers should be appointed to offices for which they are competent and should possess accomplishments necessary for the same. Appointment of unworthy persons is not at all approved.

sa: प्रेष्यमाणा विकल्पन्ते गुह्यं चाप्यनुयुञ्जते। अयाच्यं चैव याचन्ते भोज्यान्याहारयन्ति च॥
en: Ordered to do a thing, they hesitate, and give out the master's secrets. They ask for unbecoming things and take the food that is intended for the master.

sa: न हि मेऽन्यद् भवेच्छेयो वनाभ्युपगमादृते॥ इमामवस्थां प्राप्तस्य लूनपक्षस्य संजय।
en: Nothing else save an exile into the woods can be better for me who am fallen into this plight and who am shorn of my sons, O Sanjaya.

sa: दुःखेन महता राजन् संतप्तो भरतर्षभः॥ पुनर्गावल्गणिं सूतं पर्यपृच्छद् यथातथम्।
en: Overwhelined with sorrow and burning with grief, that best of Bharata's race once more enquired of his charioteer Sanjaya, the son of Gavalgana, the details of the battle.

sa: आत्मनोऽध्रुवतां पश्यंस्तांस्त्वं किमनुशोचसि। बुद्ध्या चैवानुबुद्ध्यस्व ध्रुवं हि न भविष्यसि॥
en: Meditating on your own instability, why do you grieve for them? Think with the help of your intelligence, and you will understand that you will cease to be!

sa: स हतः प्रापतद् राजन् नकुलेन महात्मना। नदीवेगादिवारुग्णस्तीरजः पादपो महान्॥
en: Thus killed by the illustrious Nakula Karna's son drooped down like a tall tree on the bank of a river thrown down by the current of the river.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच सरस्वत्याः प्रभावोऽयमुक्तस्ते द्विजसत्तम। कुमारस्याभिषेकं तु ब्रह्मन् व्याख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: Janamejaya said "You have described the inerits of the Sarasvati, O best of Brahmanas. You should, O Rishi, describe to me the investiture of Kumara by the gods.

sa: सशब्दमभवद् व्योम ज्वालामालाकुलं भृशम्। चचाल च मही कृत्स्ना सपर्वतवनदुमा॥
en: The entire sky was filled with noise and put on a terrible appearance with those flames of fire. The entire earth shook with her mountains, rivers and trees.

sa: तदिदं दैवविहितं मम संख्ये निवर्तनम्॥ नान्यत्र दैवादुद्यन्तुमिह शक्यं कथंचना
en: It seems, therefore, that my casing from fight had been ordained by destiny. It is useless for me to try to accomplish my resolution unless density becomes favorable.

sa: स पुनस्ताञ्जघानाशु बालानपि नराधिप॥ गर्भस्थैस्तु मही व्याप्ता पुनरेवाभवत् तदा।
en: Rama once more killed them quickly, not sparing even the very children, O king. The Earth again was covered with the bodies of Kshatriya children of premature birth.

sa: अभीतो विकिरशत्रून् प्रतिगृह्य शरांस्तथा। न तस्मात्रिदशा:श्रेयो भुवि पश्यन्ति किञ्चन॥
en: If a king, with his quivers full of arrows, shoots them fearlessly at his enemies, the very gods do not see any one superior to his on Earth.

sa: दुर्विदा गतिरर्थानामपि ये दिव्यचक्षुषः। जीयमाना जयन्त्यन्ये जयमाना वयं जिताः॥
en: The course of evens cannot even be ascertained even by persons possessing spiritual insight. The enemies who were defeated have become victorious. Ourselves, again, while victorious are defeated.

sa: तेनासीदतितेजस्वी दीप्तिमान् हव्यवाहनः। न चैव धारयामास गर्भ तेजोमयं तदा॥
en: On the other hand, the carrier of sacrificial libations, for that seed, became possessed of great energy and splendour. He could not bear within himself that powerful seed.

sa: भवतस्तु प्रसादेन संशप्तकगणा जिताः॥ महारणगतः पार्थो यच नासीत् पराङ्मुखः।
en: It was through your favour that the Samsaptakas were vanquished! It was through your favour that Partha had never to turn back from even the fiercest of battles!

sa: भीमसेन यमौ चोभौ रथमेकं समाश्रिताः। कृपो युयुत्सुः सूतश्च संजयश्च परंतपः॥ ते स्थैर्नगराकारैः प्रयाताः पुरुषर्षभाः। नेमिघोषेण महता कम्पयन्तो वसुन्धराम्॥
en: Bhimasena and the twin rode on a third; while those foremost of men, viz., Kripa and Yuyutsu, and that scorcher of foes, viz., Sanjaya of the charioteer caste, proceeded on their respective cars, each of which looked like a town. And all of then went on, inaking the Earth trembled with the rattle of their carwheels.

sa: रेमाते यत्र तौ नित्यं नरनारायणावृषी। अदूरादाश्रमं कञ्चिद् वासार्थमगमं तदा॥
en: Within that retreat the Rishis Nara and Narayana always spend their time happily. Not far from that place I went to another hermitage for taking up my quarter.

sa: स शेषकारिणस्तत्र शेषं पश्यन्ति सर्वशः। निःशेषकारिणो नित्यं निःशेषकरणाद् भयम्॥
en: Those kings, who do not root them out outright have no fear of their ruin, They, however, that do root them out, stand always in dread of them.'

sa: तेन मे दूयते तीव्र हृदयं भ्रातृघातिनः॥ कर्णार्जुनसहायोऽहं जयेयमपि वासवम्।
en: Having caused my brother to be killed, my heart is burning greatly. If I had both Karna and Arjuna for helping me, I could have defeated Vasudeva himself.

sa: उद्यतां पृथिवी सर्वा ससुरासुरमानवाम्॥ योधयेयं रणमुखे संक्रुद्धः किमु पाण्डवान्।
en: What shall I say of the Pandavas? When enraged, I can fight, at the van of battle, with the whole world consisting of the celestials, Asuras and men.

sa: तमदृश्यानि भूतानि रक्षांसि च समाद्रवन्। अभितः शत्रुशिविरं यान्तं साक्षादिवेश्वरम्॥
en: Many invisible beings and Rakshasas went along his right and his left as he started like the lord Mahadeva himself, for entering the camp of his enemies." SO

sa: अपुण्यपुण्योपरमे यं पुनर्भवनिर्भयाः। शान्ताः संन्यासिनो यान्ति तस्मै मोक्षात्मने नमः॥
en: Peaceful Sannyasins, freed from fear of rebirth on account of the extinction of all their sins and merits, obtain you. Salutations to you in your form of emancipation.

sa: इदं स समुहद् भूतं दैवदण्डमिवोद्यतम्॥ न चैतदभिजानामि चिन्तयन्नपि सर्वथा।
en: Again this being, who is before me, is most wonderful. He stands there like the uplifted rod of divine punishment. Thinking much even, I Cannot recognise this being.

sa: भेदमूलो विनाशो हि गणानामुपलक्षये। मन्त्रसंवरणं दुःखं बहूनामिति मे मतिः॥
en: It appears to me that disunion alone can encompass their destruction. I think it is always difficult to keep counsels close when there are many in the assemblage.

sa: यं पुरा पर्युपासीना रमयन्ति महीक्षितः। महीतलस्थं निहतं गृध्रास्तं पर्युपासते॥
en: He who was formerly encircled by kings who competed with one another to give him pleasure, alas, is now slain and lying on the ground, encircled by vultures.

sa: सर्वार्थत्यागिनं राजा कुले जातं बहुश्रुतम्। पूजयेत् तादृशं दृष्ट्वा शयनासनभोजनैः॥
en: When he beholds anchorites of high descent and great learning that have forsaken all earthly objects, he should honour them with presents of beds and seats and food.

sa: वैरपन्तिकमासाद्य यः प्रीति कर्तुमिच्छति। मृन्मयस्येव भग्नस्य यथा संधिर्न विद्यते॥
en: If a person after avenging an injury, wishes to make peace with the injured, the parties cannot be properly reunited even like the pieces of an earthen vessel.

sa: उपगृह्य तु वैराणि सान्त्वयन्ति नराधिप। अथैनं प्रतिपिंषन्ति पूर्णं घटमिवाश्मनि॥
en: Kings kill animosities by means of conciliation but, when the opportunity presents itself, they break their enemies tu pieces like earthen jars full of water dashed against stone.

sa: प्रदीप्ताश्च दिशः सर्वा धार्तराष्ट्रस्य माधव। महद् भयं वेदयन्ति तस्मिन्नुत्पातदर्शने॥
en: All the directions the encampment of the son of Dhritarashtra are ablaze as if in conflagration, O Madhava and the sight of these disturbances presages a great calamity.

sa: एवमुक्तश्च भीष्मेण धार्तराष्ट्रो जनेश्वरः। प्रहस्य सहसा राजन् विप्रतस्थे ससौबलः॥
en: Having been thus addressed by Bhishma, that lord of men, the son of Dhritarashtra (Duryodhana) laughed aloud and he suddenly went away with the son of Subala (Shakuni).

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः शान्तनवं भीष्मं प्राञ्जलिधृतराष्ट्रजः। सह सर्वैर्महीपालैरिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then did the son of Dhritarashtra, with clasped hands, along with all these rulers of the earth, say these words to Bhishma, the son of Shantanu.

sa: ततस्ते धृतसंकल्पा युद्धाय सहसैनिकाः। पाण्डवेया महाराज तां रात्रिं सुखमावसन्॥
en: Then did those sons of Pandu make up their minds for war, O great king, and passed the night with their soldiers without any mental agitation. um f

sa: विविधायुधपूर्णानि पताकाध्वजवन्ति च। समाश्च तेषां पन्थानः क्रियन्तां नगराद् बहिः॥
en: Let them be full of diverse kinds of weapons, flags and banners and let the roads leading to it out of the town be made level and cleared.

sa: दर्श च पौर्णमासं च कुर्वन् विगतमत्सरः। देवतातिथिशेषेण कुरुते देहयापनम्॥
en: Celebrating the Darsa and Paurnamashya sacrifices that guileless Rishi used to pass his days by taking the food that remained after the deities and the guests had eaten.

sa: तस्येन्द्रः सहितो देवैः साक्षात् त्रिभुवनेश्वरः। प्रत्यगृह्णान्महाराज भागं पर्वणि पर्वणि॥
en: In (all) auspicious lunar days, the lord of the three worlds, Indra accompained by the celestials, O great king, used to partake the food offered at his sacrifice.

sa: ददतो गां हिरण्यं च ब्राह्मणैरभिसंवृताः। स्तूयमाना ययू राजन् रथैर्मणिविभूषितैः॥
en: They proceeded distributing cows and gold and surrounded by Brahmanas; O king, they proceeded, hymns being sung in their praise, on chariots ornamented with gems and precious stones.

sa: अभेद्यः सर्वशस्त्राणां प्रभिन्न इव वारणः। जज्ञे द्रोणविनाशाय सत्यवादी जितेन्द्रियः॥
en: Who can not be pierced by any weapon, like an infuriated elephant-this one, a speaker of truth, and a restrainer of his senses, was born for slaying Drona.

sa: बुद्ध्याभिजानामि नरेन्द्रपुत्र न मादृशी त्वामभिभाष्टुमर्हति। मन्यो नरो वाप्यथवपि नारी॥
en: I know it, O prince, that it is not proper for me to address you thus, there is no other man or woman who can speak with you.

sa: देवापिस्तु महातेजास्त्वग्दोषी राजसत्तमः। धार्मिकः सत्यवादी च पितुः शुश्रूषणे रतः॥
en: Devapi, that best among kings though endued in his skin; but he was a virtuous man, a speaker of truth and ever devoted to attending on his father.

sa: ततोऽहं प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा मातरं सम्प्रसादयम्। नाम्ब शान्तनुना जातः कौरवं वंशमुद्वहन्॥
en: Then clasping my hands I gratified my mother by saying thus “O mother, I shall not, being begotten by Shantanu and being a supporter of the Kuru family.

sa: पीड्यन्ते ते प्रजाः सर्वा व्याधिभिभृशदारुणैः। अल्पावशिष्ठा गाङ्गेय ताः परित्रातुमर्हसि॥
en: All your subjects are being very much troubled by serve diseases and 0 son of Ganga, it is proper that you should save the few that are alive.

sa: तं भीमसेनो धावन्तमवतीर्य रथाद् बली। अभिदुत्य निजग्राह केशपक्षे ह्यमर्षणः॥
en: But getting down from his chariot the powerful Bhimasena pursued him speedily, who had thus taken to his heels and seized him by the hair of his head.

sa: द्रौपदी चाब्रवीद् भीममभिप्रेक्ष्य युधिष्ठिरम्। दासोऽयं मुच्यतां राज्ञस्त्वया पञ्चसटः कृतः॥
en: Beholding Yudhishthira Draupadi also said to Bhima, "Release him who is the slave of the king and whom you have disfigured by leaving five tufts on his head."

sa: सोमस्य लक्ष्म व्यावृत्तं राहुरर्कमुपैति च। दिवचोल्काः पतन्त्येताः सनिर्घाताः सकम्पनाः॥
