en: Rahu comes to the sun which has covered the path of the moon and from the heavens fall down meteors with loud noise and making the earth shake.

sa: असंशयं हितार्थाय ब्रूयास्त्वं मधुसूदन। सर्वं च पाण्डवाः कुर्युस्त्वद्वशित्वान्न संशयः॥
en: Doubtless, O you slayer of Madhu, you are speaking for my own good and the Pandavas too will obey all your instructions, there is no doubt about it.

sa: रावयामास लोकान् यत् तस्माद्रावण उच्यते। दशग्रीवः कामबलो देवानां भयमादधत्॥
en: Because he had terrified all creatures he was called Ravana. And the ten-headed demon, capable of having any might at will, struck terror even to the very gods.

sa: अर्थवन्त्युपपन्नानि वाक्यानि गुणवन्ति च। नैव सम्प्राप्नुवन्ति त्वां मुमूर्षुमिव भेषजम्॥
en: Like medicine to one at the point of death these words which are conducive to your interest and are otherwise well suited, do not act in your mind.

sa: विचित्य दक्षिणामाशां सपर्वतवनाकराम्। श्रान्ताः काले व्यतीते स्म दृष्टवन्तो महागुहाम्॥
en: Searching the southern direction with all its mountains, forests and mines, we got fatigued and then after the expiration of the appointed time we saw a great cave.

sa: तं प्रस्थितमभिप्रेक्ष्य कौरवाः सह राजभिः। अनुजग्मुर्नरव्याघ्रं देवा इव शतक्रतुम्॥
en: Seeing him go out, the sons of Kuru along with the other kings, followed that best among men like the gods following the performer of a hundred sacrifices.

sa: एकोऽहमिति यन्मोहान्मन्यसे मां सुयोधन। परिभूय सुदुर्बुद्धे ग्रहीतुं मां चिकीर्षसि॥
en: "O Suyodhana, since you think me to be alone out of your folly, you want to effect my capture by overpowering me, O you of very little intellect.

sa: निष्टनन्तो [भयतस्तत्र वानरराक्षसाः। हता निपतिता भूमौ न मुञ्चन्ति परस्परम्॥
en: The Rakshasas and the monkeys with terrific yells and roars killed and struck down one another on the ground but (still) they did not give up the fight.

sa: तांश्च तौ चाप्यदृश्यः स शरैर्विव्याधराक्षसः॥ स भृशं ताडयामास रावणिर्माययाऽऽवृतः।
en: But the Rakshasa being invisible, pierced them and the two (brothers Rama and Lakshmana), with arrows hidden by illusion, the son of Ravana sorely afflicted them (the monkeys).

sa: तौ वीरौ शरबन्धेन बद्धाविन्द्रजिता रणे। रेजतुः पुरुषव्याघ्रौ शकुन्ताविव पञ्जरे॥
en: Those heroes, those valiant of men, thus covered by that net-work of arrows on the field of battle looked like a couple of birds confined in a cage.

sa: शरीरधातवो ह्यस्य मांसं रुधिरमेव च। नेशुर्ब्रह्मास्त्रनिर्दग्धा न च भस्माप्यदृश्यत॥
en: The ingredients of his body together with his flesh and blood were all so totally consumed by the Brahma weapon that the ashes even could not be seen.

sa: अहमष्येकमेवास्यां जनयिष्यामि गालव। पुत्रं द्विज गतं मागं गमिष्यामि परैरहम्॥
en: I too shall beget only one son on her, O Galava, and, O twice born one I shall go along the course followed by others in this matter.

sa: सत्यवानुवाच शिरोरुजा निवृत्ता मे स्वस्थान्यङ्गानि लक्षये। मातापितृभ्यामिच्छामि संगमं त्वत्प्रसादजम्॥
en: Satyavana said : I have recovered from the headache and my limbs are in a sound condition. I am therefore, through your favour, desirous of seeing my parents.

sa: अत्र पश्चादहः सूर्यो विसर्जयति गाः स्वयम्। पश्चिमेत्यभिविख्याता दिगियं द्विजसत्तम॥
en: Here does the sun abandon his rays himself last of all ((Paschata) in the day; this is known as the western direction, O best among the twice born.

sa: तत्र भार्यासहायः स वृतो वृद्धैस्तपोधनैः। आश्वासितोऽपि चित्रार्थैः पूर्वराज्ञां कथाश्रयैः॥
en: There the aged ascetics surrounding the old man together with his wife began to console him with stories of wonderful import about the kings of by gone ages.

sa: पक्षवातेन महता रुद्ध्वा त्रिभुवनं खगः। सुपर्णः परमक्रुद्धो वासवं समुपाद्रवत्॥
en: And Suparna, the wanderer of the sky, obstructing the there worlds as it were by the heavy wind caused by his wings and being very, came to Vasava.

sa: इदमत्यद्भुतं भीरु यतो जातोऽस्मि भाविनी। दृष्टवान् देवगर्भोऽयं मन्येऽस्मान् समुपागतः॥
en: "O timid lady, since my very birth I have never witnessed such a marvel. I think, this boy that has come to us, is begotten by a celestials,

sa: तस्याः प्रदानसमयं मातलिः सह भार्यया। ज्ञात्वा विममृशे राजंस्तत्परः परिचिन्तयन्॥
en: Matali, along with his wife knowing that the time for giving her away in marriage has arrived, became sorrowful, o king, thinking what to do in the future.

sa: पर्यस्तां पृथिवीं सर्वां साश्वां सरथकुञ्जराम्। यो मोचयेन्मृत्युपाशात् प्राप्नुयाद् धर्ममुत्तमम्॥
en: He that will relive this earth of her burden consisting of horses, chariots, elephants, he that will liberate her from curse of Death will earn great religious merit.

sa: नकुल उवाच अश्वबन्धो भविष्यामि विराटनृपतेरहम्। सर्वथा ज्ञानसम्पन्नः कुशलः परिरक्षणे॥
en: Nakula said I shall be the keeper of the horses of king Virata; I possess thorough knowledge of the business, and am expert in the tending of them,

sa: शरीरं च मृतस्यैकं समबनन्त पाण्डवाः। विवर्जयिष्यन्ति नरा दूरादेव शमीमिमाम्॥
en: There also the Pandavas fastened a corpse so that the people getting the bad smell and saying-"there is a corpse fastened, will shun this Shami from a distance."

sa: मायैषा सत्यमेवैतच्छौतद् भूरिदक्षिण। जानामि त्वन्मतं राजन् गूढं बाह्येन कर्मणा॥
en: It is true that this proceeds out of deception and insincerity and therefore it is cxceedingly improper. I know your secret intentions, O king from your outward acts.

sa: मम पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च सर्वे दुर्योधनादृते। प्रत्युद्यास्यन्ति दाशार्ह रथैर्पष्टैः स्वलंकृताः॥
en: All my sons and grandsons with the exception of Duryodhana will go forward, mounted on chariots and with ornaments on to receive the scion of the Dasharha race.

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच त्वमन्यदा भीमसेन युद्धमेव प्रशंससि। वधाभिनन्दिनः क्रूरान् धार्तराष्ट्रान् मिमर्दिषुः॥
en: The blessed God said 0 Bhimasena, at other times you approving of war rejoiced at the prospect of killing the crooked minded sons of Dhritarashtra, who oppress others.

sa: दुहिता जनकस्यापि वैदेही यदि ते श्रुता। पतिमन्वचरत् सीता महारण्यनिवासिनम्॥
en: You may have heard that Janaka's daughter Sita, the princess of Videha, went in the wake of her lord while he was dwelling in a great dreary forest.

sa: शूरोऽभिमानी पापात्मा सर्वार्थेषु च मुग्धवान्। दारामर्शी महाभाग लभतेऽर्थान् बहूनपि॥
en: That wicked-souled Kichaka is war-like, proud, outrager of female modesty and engrossed in all objects of pleasure; O blessed one, he acquires plenty of money (from the king).

sa: उन्मादमेके पुष्यन्ति यान्त्यन्ये द्विषतां वशम्। दास्यमेके च गच्छन्ति परेषामर्थहेतुना॥
en: One class of men become insane; another go under the control of their enemies; and a third become slaves for the sake of getting the wealth of others.

sa: काशिभिश्चेदिपञ्चालैर्मत्स्यैश्च मधुसूदन। भवता चैव नाथेन पञ्च ग्रामा वृता मया।॥
en: Five villages were only asked by me, who have the Kashis, the Chedis, the Panchalas and the Matsyas for my supporters and your exalted self for my lord.

sa: सम्भोजनं संकथनं सम्प्रश्नोऽथ समागमः। एतानि ज्ञातिकार्याणि न विरोधः कदाचन॥
en: Dining in one another's company and conversing among, one another, inquiring about one another's health and living together, these are the duties of cousins and quarrel is never.

sa: अस्य वर्षस्य शेषं चेद् व्यतीयुरिह पाण्डवाः। निवृत्तसमयास्ते हि सत्यव्रतपरायणाः॥
en: And if they can truly pass the remaining portion of this year hidden from our view in pursuance of their vow they will then have fulfilled their pledge.

sa: निर्दग्धं भीमसेनेन सैन्यं रथहयद्विपम्। गतिमग्नेरिव प्रेक्ष्य स्मर्ताऽसि वचनस्य मे॥
en: Beholding your army composed of chariot, horses and elephants burnt up as it were by Bhimasena like the path followed by a fire, will you remember my words.

sa: यदा द्रक्ष्यसि भीमेन कुञ्जरान् विनिपातितान्। विशीर्णदन्तान् गिर्याभान् भिन्नकुम्भान् सशोणितान्।।
en: When you will see your elephants, big as mountains, felled down by Bhima with their tusks broken and with blood flowing resembling a broken pot (with water flowing).

sa: दुर्योधन निवर्तस्व युद्धाद् भरतसत्तम। न हि युद्धं प्रशंसन्ति सर्वावस्थमरिंदम॥
en: O Duryodhana, O you best among the race of Bharata, turn your mind away from fight; war is not desirable under all conditions, O you subduer of enemies.

sa: यदिदं ते विलपितं पाण्डवान् प्रति भारत। अनीशेनेव राजेन्द्र सर्वमेतन्निरर्थकम्॥
en: All these lamentations of yours for the sons of Pandu, O Bharata, as if you had no hand in the matter, are all useless, O chief among kings.

sa: चस्तान् गन्धर्वराजेन मज्जतो ह्यप्लवेऽम्भसि। आनिनाय पुनः पार्थः पुत्रांस्ते राजसत्तम॥
en: Your sons, O best of kings, overpowered by the king of the Gandharvas and thus sinking as it were in a scoreless open, were brought back by Partha.

sa: इदं तु नाभिजानामि तव धीरस्य नित्यशः। यत् पुत्रवशमागच्छेस्तत्त्वज्ञः सव्यसाचिनः॥
en: I do not know how it is that you, who are ever wise and know about the attributes of Savyasachin, allow yourself to be controlled by your sons.

sa: बलवान् पार्थो समर्थो दृढधन्वा जितक्लमः। भवेत् सुतमुलं युद्धं सर्वशोऽप्यपराजयः॥
en: Partha of firm grasp on the bow however is able, mighty and has conquered fatigue; there will be terrible fight between them, but both sides will remain undefeated.

sa: शुश्रुषमाणाः पार्थानां वाचो धर्मार्थसंहिताः। धृतराष्ट्रमुखाः सर्वे ययू राजसभां शुभाम्॥
en: Desirous of hearing the message of those sons of Pritha, full of virtue and worldly benefit, all with Dhritarashtra at their head went to the blessed Council Chamber.

sa: वर्तमाना यथाशास्त्रं प्राप्य चापि महीमिमाम्। सत्कुर्वन्ति महाभागा गुरून् सुविगुणानपि॥
en: Duly following the the scriptures they obtained this entire earth and those great men always act respectfully to their elders even if the latter prove adverse to them,

sa: परिच्छदेन क्षेत्रेण वेश्मना परिचर्यया। परीक्षेत कुलं राजन् भोजनाच्छादनेन च॥
en: Forgiveness ever destroys anger; good behaviour neutralises the effects of evil omens in the appearance of a man. By means of one's dress, sphere of action, house, behaviour,

sa: महते योऽपकाराय नरस्यं प्रभवेन्नरः। तेन वैरं समासज्य दूरस्थोऽस्मीति नाश्वसेत्॥
en: After provoking the hostility of a man who is capable of doing great injury to another, one should not console himself by saying "I am at a distance."

sa: ततः शान्तनवो भीष्मो वाम पार्श्वमताडयत्। पश्यतः प्रतिसंधाय विध्यतः सव्यसाचिनः॥
en: Bhishma, the son of Shantanu suddenly penetrated the left collateral of Arjuna's body who had wounded the Kauravas' army in course of the fierce battle so fought. are

sa: ततः पार्थोऽभ्यनुज्ञातो विराटेन महात्मना। प्रददौ तानि वासांसि विराटदुहितुः स्वयम्॥
en: Arjuna, in disguise of Brihannala then gave all garments took-off from the bodies of great commanders (rathis) to Uttara, daughter of Virata in compliance with the king's order.

sa: एष सर्वान् महीपालान् करदान् समकारयत्। वैश्यानिव महाभागो विवशान् स्ववशानपि॥
en: This great man had made all kings tax payers like Vaishyas (by subjugation) and by directing them varied ways (viz. all kings used to pay him taxes imposed).

sa: चत्वार्याह महाराज साधस्कानि बृहस्पतिः। पृच्छते त्रिदशेन्द्राय तानीमानि निबोध मे॥
en: Four things, O great king, were declared to bear fruit instantaneously by Brihaspati on being asked by the chief of the celestial; they are these, listen to me.

sa: अक्षौहिणीपती राजन् महावीर्यपराक्रमः। विचित्रकवचाः शूरा विचित्रध्वजकार्मुकाः॥ विचित्राभरणाः सर्वे विचित्ररथवाहनाः। विचित्रस्रग्धराः सर्वे विचित्राम्बरभूषणाः॥ स्वदेशवेषाभरणा वीराः शतसहस्रशः। तस्य सेनाप्रणेतारो बभूवुः क्षत्रियर्षभाः॥
en: That man of great prowess and strength was, O king, the lord of an Akshauhini and heroes-best among the Kshatriyas with diverse armours, diverse omaments and all riding cars diverse and animals, with diverse garlands, all putting on diverse dresses the dresses and ornaments of their respective lands, counted by hundreds and thousands ecame the leaders of his army.

sa: तस्य दृष्ट्वा तपोवीर्यं सत्यं चामिततेजसः। विषादमगमच्छक इन्द्रोऽयं मा भवेदिति॥
en: Shakra was depressed in spirits, at seeing the strength in devotion and truthfulness of the one with unrivaled power, for fear lest he be the chief among gods.

sa: संरब्धयोस्तदा घोरं सुचिरं भरतर्षभ। यदा व्यवर्धत रणे वृत्रो बलसमन्वितः॥ त्वष्टस्तेजोबलाविद्धस्तदा शक्रो न्यवर्तत। निवृत्ते च तदा देवा विषादमगमन् परम्॥
en: 0 best among the race of Bharata, the fierce contest between the two, fired with ire, lasted for a long time, when in battle Vritra, possessed of power, got the victory through the strength due to the inner spirit of Tvashtri. Shakra turned his back and he turning his back the gods were very much depressed.

sa: पराक्रमं मे यदवेदयन्त तेषामर्थं संजय केशवस्य। र्गावल्गणे नाधिगच्छामि शान्तिम्॥
en: Remembering what has been brought to my notice regarding the might of Keshava and the deeds of Vishnu I got no peace of mind, O son of Gavalgani.

sa: पुनः प्रकाशमभवत् तमसा ग्रस्यते पुनः। भवत्यदर्शनो लोकः पुनरप्सु निमज्जति॥
en: (In consequence of which) now the world displayed itself, now it was enveloped in darkness, now it disappeared (from view) and, now again, it was submerged into water.

sa: त्वत्कृते बन्धुवर्गाश्च गतसत्त्वा इवासते। अन्वेष्टारो ब्राह्मणाश्च भ्रमन्ति शतशो महीम्॥
en: Your friends and relatives, though living, are like the dead on your account; and hundreds of Brahmanas are wandering about over the whole world in quest of you.

sa: अस्या नूनं पुनर्लाभान्नैषधः प्रीतिमेष्यति। राजा राज्यपरिभ्रष्टः पुनर्लब्ध्वा च मेदिनीम्॥
en: Certainly the king of the Nishadhas will obtain great delight by regaining his wife, even as the monarch, deprived of his kingdom, does by recovering his lost territories.

sa: ततः स भार्यामभ्येत्य प्रोवाच पृथिवीपतिः। महर्षिर्वीर्यवानेष क्रुद्धः शापाग्निना दहेत्॥
en: That ruler of earth then, going to his wife, said, "The great Rishi possesses great power. If angry, he can consumne us by the fire of his curse.

sa: साक्षात् कुबेरेण कृताश्च तस्मिन् नगोत्तमे संवृतकूलरोधसः। कादम्बकारण्डवहंसजुष्टाः पद्माकुलाः पुष्करिणीरपश्यन्॥
en: On that excellent mountain they beheld tanks, excavated by Kubera himself, full of lotuses and frequented by Kadamvas, Karandavas and swans and with their banks covered with (trees).

sa: इत्येतच्छ्रुत्वा स राजाब्रवीत् तिष्ठ तावद् यावदिमौ वृद्धौ यथास्थानं प्रतिपादयामीति॥
en: Having heard this, the king said, “Let the car stay here so long I do not take back the old persons from the places whence I brought them."

sa: क्रोधमूलो विनाशो हि प्रजानामिह दृश्यते। तत् कथं मादृशः क्रोधमुत्सृजेल्लोकनाशनम्॥
en: Anger is in this world, the root of the destruction of mankind; how can, one like me indulge in anger which brings about the destruction of the world?

sa: शोणस्य ज्योतिरथ्यायाः संगमे नियतः शुचिः। तर्पयित्वा पितृन् देवानग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत्॥
en: Living with purity at the confluence of the Shona and the Jyotirathi and offering oblations to the Pitris and the celestials, one obtains the fruits of Agnishtoma sacrifice.

sa: ममाश्रमसमीपे वै समेषु मरुधन्वसु। समुद्रो बालुकापूर्ण उज्जालक इति स्मृतः॥
en: Near my hermitage there is a large desert, a sea of sand, known by the name of Ujjalaka. It occupies a level country and it has no water.

sa: आक्रुष्टस्ताडितः क्रुद्धः क्षमते यो बलीयसा। यश्च नित्यं जितक्रोधो विद्वानुत्तमपूरुषः॥
en: He is considered as an excellent and learned person who, having conquered his anger, always shows his forgiveness even when insulted, oppressed and excited by a strong man.

sa: शाकवृत्तिः फलैर्वापि कौमारं विन्दते परम्। कण्वाश्रमं ततो गच्छेच्छ्रीजुष्टं लोकपूजितम्॥
en: He who (going there) lives on vegetables or fruits acquires the state of Kumara. One should then go to the hermitage of Kansa, worshipped by the whole world.

sa: समेत्य लोकपालैस्तु सर्वैर्वैवस्वतादिभिः। द्रष्टास्यनघ देवेन्द्रं स च तेऽस्त्राणि दास्यति॥
en: O sinless being, you will behold the lord of the celestials, together with Vaivasvata and all the Lokapalas, who (the lord of the celestials) will grant you weapons.

sa: व्यजनै—यमानोऽपि तावत् प्रज्वलते न सः। यावच्चारुपुटौष्ठेन वायुना न विधूयते॥
en: Being fanned as much as was possible, the fire did not blaze up, till it was not blown by the breaths of the sweet lips of that girl

sa: भूयश्चैव च तप्तव्यं तपश्चरणमुत्तमम्। स्वर्गं त्ववश्यं गन्तव्यं त्वया शत्रुनिषूदन॥
en: O destroyer of foes, you will have to practise severe austerities again, for O Pandava, you will surely have to stay in heaven (now in this mortal frame).

sa: संसिद्ध्यस्व महाबाहो कुरु कार्यमनन्तरम्। पश्य पुण्यकृताँल्लोकान् सशरीरो दिवं व्रज॥
en: O creation of powerful arms, acquire perfection first and then perform your task. Behold the regions of the virtuous and repair to heaven even in the (mortal) frame.

sa: ततो गच्छेत्धर्मज्ञः स्थाणोस्तीर्थमुमापतेः। नाम्ना भद्रवटं नाम त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्॥
en: The virtuous man then should go to the Tirtha of Sthanu, the husband of Uma, which is known all over the three worlds by the name of Bhadravata.

sa: नर्मदां तु समासाद्य नदीं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुताम्॥ तर्पयित्वा पितॄन् देवानग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत्।
en: Going to the river Narmada which is celebrated all over the three worlds, he obtains the fruit of Agnishtoma by offering oblations to the Pitris and the celestials.

sa: उन्मत्तान् मन्यते बाल: सर्वानागतनिश्चयान्। धर्माभिशङ्को नान्यस्मात् प्रमाणमधिगच्छति॥ आत्मप्रमाण उन्नद्धः श्रेयसो ह्यवमन्यकः। इन्द्रियप्रीतिसम्बद्धं यदिदं लोकसाक्षिकम्। एतावन्मन्यते बालो. मोहमन्यत्र गच्छति॥
en: The fool, who doubts religion and disregards virtue and being proud of the proof of his own reasoning, does not receive it from others, considers all these sages who look upon the future as present, like mad man. He considers the external world as conducive to the gratification of senses and is blind to everything else.

sa: ततो वापी महापुण्यां पयोष्णीं सरितां वराम्। पितृदेवार्चनरतो गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: Then going to that best of water, that lake, called Payoshni and worshipping the Pitris and the celestials, one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sa: तत्राश्रमो वसिष्ठस्य त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः। तत्रोष्य रजनीमेकां गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: There is the hermitage of Vasishtha, celebrated over the three worlds. He who lives there only for one night obtains the merit of giving away one thousand kine.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नो द्रोणमृत्युरिति विप्रथितं वचः। मद्वधाय श्रुतोऽप्यष लोके चाप्यति विश्रुतः॥
en: “Dhristadyumna is the slayer of Drona" is the general belief. I have heard that he is born to kill me. This is also widely known in the world.

sa: यश्च दिष्टपरो लोके यश्चापि हठवादिकः। उभावपि शठावेतौ कर्मबुद्धिः प्रशस्यते॥
en: Whoever in this world believe in Destiny and whoever in chance are both the worst of people; those only are praiseworthy who believe in the efficacy of acts.

sa: स द्वारकां परित्यज्य क्रूरो वृष्णिभिरादितः। सौभमास्थाय राजेन्द्र दिवमाचक्रमे तदा।॥
en: O king of kings, the wicked-minded (Shalva), thus defeated by the Vrishni, ascended (his car) Saubha made of precious metals; and leaving Dvarka he disappeared through the skies.

sa: अन्येषां कर्म सफलमस्माकमपि वा पुनः। विप्रकर्षण बुध्येत कृतकर्मा यथाफलम्।॥
en: The actions of others have been seen crowned with success and ours might be as well; how can one, performing action, perceive beforehand what would be the result?

sa: एषा सा यमुना राजन् महर्षिगणसेविता। नानायज्ञचिता राजन् पुण्या पापभयापहा॥
en: This is that Yamuna, O king which is frequented by the great Rishis, the scene of many sacrifices, it is holy and it destroys all fear of sin.

sa: स्त्र्युवाच नाहं बलाका विप्रर्षे त्यज क्रोधं तपोधन॥ अनया क्रुद्धया दृष्ट्या क्रुद्धः किं मां करिष्यसि। नावजानाम्यहं विप्रान् देवैस्तुल्यान् मनस्विनः॥
en: The Woman said: O sage-like Brahmana, O you who are possessed of the wealth of asceticism, do not consider that I am the female crane. Wrathful as you are, what will you do to me by this your wrathful look? Really I never disrespect the Brahmanas, who are like the celestials themselves, possessed of great energy.

sa: द्रौपद्युवाच यत् तत् सौगन्धिकं राजन्नाहृतं मातरिश्वना। तन्मया भीमसेनस्य प्रीतयाद्योपपादितम्॥
en: "O king, the golden lotus that was brought here by the wind, I showed to Bhimasena out of love. I also told that hero "If you can find.

sa: भवत: प्रियमित्येवं महद् व्यसनमीदृशम्। धर्मकामे प्रतीतस्य प्रतिपन्नाः स्म भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, you are firin in the desire of acquiring virtue. It was to please you that we suffered ourselves to be overwhelmed with such calamities.

sa: संस्तूयमानो विप्रेन्द्रर्मानयानो द्विजोत्तमान्। कल्की चरिष्यति महीं सदा दस्युवधे रतः॥
en: Showing his reverence for the excellent twice-born ones was engaged in killing the thieves. That Kalki, will rove over the earth being adored by the foremost of Brahmanas.

sa: यत्रोत्तराणां सर्वेषामृषीणां नाहुषस्य च। अग्नेश्चैवात्र संवादः काश्यपस्य च भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, here a conference took place between Agni and the Rishi Kashyapa and between the son of Nahusha (Yayati) and the Rishis of the north.

sa: हाहाकृतमभूत् सैन्यं शाल्वस्य पृथिवीपते। नष्टसंज्ञे निपतिते तदा सौभपतौ नृपे॥
en: O ruler of earth, seeing their king, the lord of Saubha drop down senseless (on the ground), the soldiers of Shalva sent up exclamations of "Oh," and "Alas."

sa: शम्बरस्य वधे घोरः संग्रामः सुमहानभूत्। सारथ्यं देवराजस्य तत्रापि कृतवानहम्॥
en: (And) in that mighty and terrible encounter, which took place for the destruction of the (Asura) Shambara, I acted as the charioteer of the lord of the gods.

sa: सुहृदः सुहृदोऽन्यांश्च दुर्हदश्चापि दुहृदः। सम्यक प्रवृत्तान् पुरुषान् न सम्यगनुपश्यतः॥
en: Good men acting in an exemplary way are not praised by other good men, nor bad men acting in a contrary way are praised by other wicked men.

sa: अमित्रं मित्रसम्पन्नं मित्रैर्भिन्दन्ति पण्डिताः। भिन्नैर्मित्रैः परित्यक्तं दुर्बलं कुर्वते वशम्॥
en: Those, that are learned, alienate the friends of the foe that possesses friends. Having thus weakened him by making his friends abandon him, they bring him to subjugation.

sa: तान् चाम्यगजान् दृष्ट्वा सर्वे वनगजास्तदा। समाद्रवन्त वेगेन जिघांसन्तो मदोत्कटाः॥
en: Beholding those domesticated elephants, the wild ones, maddened at the fury, rushed towards them with the object of killing them, while the juice was exuding from their temples.

sa: शरीरनियमं प्राहुर्ब्राह्मणा मानुषं व्रतम्। मनोविशुद्धां बुद्धिं च दैवमाहुव्रतं द्विजाः॥
en: The Brahmanas have said that to regulate one's body is the observance of human vows and to purify one's mind and understanding is the observance of celestials vows.

sa: लपेटिकां ततो गच्छेत् पुण्यां पुण्योपशोभिताम्॥ वाजपेयमवाप्नोति देवैः सर्वैश्च पूज्यते।
en: Then one should go to the sacred Lapetika graced by the presence of the virtuous. One obtains the fruits of Vajapeya sacrifice and becomes adored by the celestials.

sa: तत्र स्नात्वा नरो नूनं वाजपेयमवाप्नुयात्। सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा गच्छेच्च परमां गतिम्॥
en: Bathing there a man is certain to obtain the fruits of the Vajapeya sacrifice. His soul becoming pure with all his sins destroyed, he obtains the highest state.

sa: तामुवाचानवद्याङ्गीं सार्थस्य महतः प्रभुः। सार्थवाहः शुचिर्नाम शृणु कल्याणि मद्वचः॥
en: Thereupon the lord of that great caravan, the leader of it, by name Suchi, said unto that damsel of faultless limbs. "O blessed one! listen to my words."

sa: अयं हि दृश्यते पार्थ सर्वपापप्रणाशनः। अत्रोपस्पृश्य चैव त्वं सर्वपापप्रणाशने॥
en: O son of Pritha, by seeing it, one is cleansed of all his sins. Perform your oblations here in this place which is capable of destroying all sins.

sa: तत्रस्थोऽथ महीपालो योधयामास तां पुरीम्। अभिसारेण सर्वेण तन युद्धमवर्तत॥
en: Thereupon, that ruler of earth, stationing himself in the sky, began to fight with that city. The battle commenced with a thick shower of weapons form all sides.

sa: न वै परीक्षसे सम्यगसह्यं शत्रुसम्भवम्। ज्येष्ठपुत्रस्य हृच्छोकं किमर्थं नावबुध्यसे॥
en: Why do you not after due enquiry ascertain the cause of the grief that is in the heart of your eldest son, the grief caused by the enemy?

sa: तं तथा प्रस्थितं वीरं शालस्कन्धोरुमर्जुनम्॥ मनांस्यादाय सर्वेषां कृष्णा वचनमब्रवीत्।
en: Then when the heroic Arjuna of thighs like the trunks of the Sala tree was about to start, taking away the hearts of all, Krishna (Draupadi) thus spoke.

sa: यथा चैवोक्तवान् भीमस्त्वामुद्दिश्य सबान्धवम्। कर्ताहं कर्मणस्तस्य कुरु कार्याणि सर्वशः॥
en: I shall certainly accomplish all which Bhima has said as regards you with all your followers. If you have anything to do, do it before that day comes.

sa: न हिंस्यात् सर्वभूतानि मैत्रायगणतश्चरेत्। नेदं जीवितमासाद्य वैरं कुर्वीत केनचित्॥
en: We must not do harm to any creature and must live in amity with all. In this our present existence we must not avenge ourselves on any creature.

sa: गतो हि पक्षतां तेषां पार्षतः परवीरहा। स्थातिरथसंख्यायां योऽग्रणीरर्जुनो युवा॥
en: The slayer of hostile heroes, the son of Prishata (Drupada), has taken the side of that your hero who stands at the head of all great car warriors.

sa: पतमानोऽद्य नरके भवतास्मि समुद्धृतः। भवितव्यमथैवं च यद् दृष्टोऽसि मयानघ।॥
en: O sinless one, I was at the point of falling into hell, but I have been saved by you. It was ordained and therefore I did meet you.

sa: दुष्करं हि कृतं कर्म जानता जातिमात्मनः। लोकवृत्तान्ततत्त्वज्ञ नित्यं धर्मपरायण॥
en: O virtuous man, O man learned in the ways of the world, in obedience to the customs of your present caste (Fowler), you have pursued these wicked ways.

sa: भीष्मद्रोणौ समानाय्य कृपं बाह्रीकमेव च। वैचित्रवीर्यं राजानमलं द्यूतेन कौरव॥ पुत्राणां तव राजेन्द्र त्वनिमित्तमिति प्रभो। तत्राचक्षमहं दोषान् यैर्भवान् व्यतिरोपितः॥
en: And by inviting to my help Bhishma, Drona, Kripa and Valhika. O descendant of Kuru, I would have said to the king, the son of Vichitravirya, for your sake, "O lord of kings, your sons should desist from gambling." I would have also pointed out the evils by which you have been reduced to this distress.

sa: ततो महर्षयः सर्वे जग्मुर्देवं पिनाकिनम्। निवेदयिषवः पार्थं तपस्युचे समास्थितम्॥
en: Thereupon all the great Rishis went to the god, the wielder of trident (Shiva) and told him that the son of Pritha (Arjuna) was engaged in austere asceticism.

sa: साक्षी वा विब्रुवन् साक्ष्यं गोकर्णशिथिलश्चरन्। सहस्रं वारुणान् पाशानात्मनि प्रतिमुश्चति॥
en: A man, who is cited as a witness with respect to any matter of ocular or auricular knowledge, speaks falsely, brings upon him one thousand Pashas of Varuna,

sa: न हि मद्वाणजालानामुत्सृष्टानां सहस्रशः। शक्तोऽन्यः सहितुं वेगमते देवं पिनाकिनम्॥
en: Except the deity, the wielder of Pinaka, there is none else that can with stand the force of the thousands of arrows shot by me from the Gandiva.

sa: पुण्डरीकमवाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्। उष्यैकां रजनीं तत्र गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: He then obtains the fruits of Pundarika sacrifice and saves his own race. Living there for one night, one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sa: मृष्यन्ति कुरवश्चमे मन्ये कालस्य पर्ययम्। सुषां दुहितरं चैव क्लिश्यमानामनर्हतीम्॥
en: She, whom the Pandavas did not suffer to be touched (even) by the wind before, is to day suffered by them to be persecuted by the wicked men.

sa: गत्वा सुदेव नगरीमयोध्यावासिनं नृपम्। ऋतुपर्णं वचो ब्रूहि सम्पतन्निव कामगः॥
en: “O Sudeva, like a bird which falls straight, do you at once depart to the city of Ayodhya and tell king Ritupara, Who dwells in it, these words:

sa: लोहितैश्च घनैर्युक्तां पूर्वां संध्यां शतक्रतुः। अपश्यल्लोहितोदं च भगवान् वरुणालयम्॥
en: Shatakratu saw that the morning twilight was tinged with red clouds. The exalted one also saw that the abode of Varuna (ocean) had become as red as blood.

sa: पितृष्वसुः कृते दुःखं सुमहन्मर्षयाम्यहम्। दिष्ट्या हीदं सर्वराज्ञां संनिधावद्य वर्तते॥
en: I have patiently born all these for the sake of my father's sister. It is, however, very fortunate that (today) all this has happened before all these kings.

sa: पुरुषादानि सत्त्वानि पक्षिणोऽथ मृगास्तथा। नगराणां विहारेषु चैत्येष्वपि च शेरते॥
en: Beast of prey and other animals and birds are seen to lie down in places of public entertainments, in cities and towns, as well as in sacred temples.

sa: नूनमन्तः कुलस्यायं भविता नचिरादिव। तथा हि कुरवः सर्वे लोभमोहपरायणाः॥
en: It is certain that as all the Kurus have become the slaves of covetousness and folly, the destruction of this our race will happen on no distant date.

sa: युगान्ते मनुजव्याघ्र भवन्ति बहुजन्तवः। न तथा घ्राणयुक्ताश्च सर्वगन्धा विशाम्पते॥
en: O foremost of men, at the end of the Yuga animals enormously increase. O rulers of men, perfumes even do not become agreeable to our sense of smell.

sa: यस्येमे कुण्डले दिव्ये सहजे देवनिर्मिते। कवचं च महाबाहो बालार्कसदृशप्रभम्॥
en: Who is adorned with the celestials earrings of heavenly make and with the armour possessing the splendour of the rising sun, with (both of) which he was born.

sa: रथमादित्यसंकाशमास्थितः कनकप्रभम्। तं दृष्ट्वा दैत्यसेना सा व्यद्रवत् सहसा रणे॥
en: He rode on a golden chariot as bright as the sun, drawn by chest-nut horses. Seeing him the Daitya forces suddenly lost heart in the field of battle.

sa: ततोऽर्जुनो हृष्टमना गङ्गायामाप्लुतः शुचिः। जजाप जप्यं कौन्तेयो विधिवत् कुरुनन्दनः॥
en: Thereupon Arjuna, the descendant of Kuru and the son of Kunti bathing in the Ganges and becoming purified and with a contented mind, duly repeated his customary prayers.

sa: अतिहासातिरोषौ च क्रोधस्थानं च वर्जये। निरताहं सदा सत्ये भर्तृणामुपसेवने।॥
en: I always refrain from laughing loudly or indulging in high passion and from everything that may give offence. O Satyabhama, I am always engaged in serving my husbands.

sa: उपस्थितं वृद्धमन्धं पितरं पश्य भारत। प्रेक्षापूर्वं मया द्यूतमिदमासीदुपेक्षितम्॥ मित्राणि द्रष्टुकामेन पुत्राणां च बलाबलम्। अशोच्याः कुरवो राजन् येषां त्वमनुशासिता॥ मन्त्री च विदुरो धीमान् सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः। त्वयि धर्मोऽर्तुने धैर्यं भीमसेने पराक्रमः॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, look at me, your father, present here who am old, and blind. It was for meeting with our friends, and also for examination the strength and weakness of my children that I allowed out of policy this match at dice to proceed. O king, there is no fear for those Kurus who are under your sway and who follow the counsel of the greatly intelligent Vidura learned in all Shastras. In you is virtue, in Arjuna is patience, and in Bhimasena is prowess,

sa: ततः सुजाता परमार्तरूपा शापाद् भीता सर्वमेवाचचक्षे। वित्यब्रवीच्छ्वेतकेतुं स विप्रः॥
en: Thereupon Sujata greatly afflicted and afraid of his curse told him all that had happened. Having heard all, that Brahmana (Ashtavakra) spoke in the night thus to Shvataketu.

sa: सर्वमाम्भसमेवासीत् खं द्योश्च नरपुङ्गव। एवंभूते तदा लोके संकुले भरतर्षभ॥
en: O foremost of men, there was water everywhere; the water covered the heaven and the sky. O best of the Bharata race, when the world was thus flooded,

sa: संनद्धो ह्यर्जुनो याति विधृत्य परमेषुधी। गाण्डीवं मुहुरादत्ते निःश्वसंश्च निरीक्षते॥
en: Even now Arjuna, attired in armour and furnished with couple of quivers, is proceeding, frequently taking up the Gandiva (bow) and breathing hard and casting angry glances around.

sa: अस्य धर्मप्रवृत्तस्य पार्थिवत्वं चिकीर्षतः। करानस्मै प्रयच्छामः सोऽयमस्मान् न मन्यते॥
en: We have paid him tribute only because he was desirous of obtaining the imperial dignity from the motive of virtue. He it is who is now insulting us.

sa: ब्राह्मणेन भवेच्चीर्णं व्रतं द्वादशवार्षिकम्। इतरेषां तु वर्णानां सर्वपापं प्रणश्यति॥
en: If he is a Brahmana, he will obtain the fruit of observing twelve years vows and if he is of other castes, all his sins will be destroyed.

sa: येषामहं लोककृतामीश्वराणां महात्मनाम्। न पादरजसा तुल्यो मनस्ते तेषु वर्तताम्॥
en: Do you lead your heart towards those illustrious cclestials, who are the creators of the worlds and even with the dust of whose feet I aim not equal.

sa: तं ते प्रवरयामासुर्निरासुश्च परावसुम्। ततो देवा वरं तस्मै ददुरग्निपुरोगमाः॥
en: They appointed him as the chief priest of the sacrifice and caused Paravasu to be dismissed. Then the celestials with Agni at the head, bestowed upon him boons.

sa: बालधिरुवाच यथेमे पर्वताः शश्वत् तिष्ठन्ति सुरसत्तमाः। अक्षयास्तन्निमित्तं मे सुतस्यायुभविष्यति॥
en: Valadhi said: O foremost of the celestials, these mountains are existing for an ever-lasting time; indestructible as they are, they will be the instrumental of my son's immortality.

sa: अनीचैर्नाप्यविषयैर्नाधर्मिष्ठैर्विशेषतः। ये गुणाः कीर्तिता लोकेधर्मकामार्थसम्भवाः। लोकाचारेषु सम्भूता वेदोक्ताः शिष्टसम्मताः॥ ते युष्मासु समस्ताश्च व्यस्ताश्चैवेह सद्गुणाः। इच्छामो गुणवन्मध्ये वस्तुं श्रेयोऽभिकाक्षिणः।।
en: All those attributes, which are spoken of in the world as the source of religious merit, worldly prosperity and sensual pleasure, which are highly regarded by men, extolled in the Vedas and approved by the good, exist in you separately and jointly. Desiring our own welfare, we wish to live among men who possess such attributes.

sa: एवं विजित्य नकुलो दिशं वरुणपालिताम्। प्रतीची वासुदेवेन निर्जितां भरतर्षभ॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, thus did Nakula conquer the west, presided over by Varuna, the at countries that had been once before conquered by Vasudeva (Krishna).

sa: छद्मना निर्जितास्ते तु कर्शिताश्च महावने। तपोनित्याश्च राधेय समर्थाश्च महारथाः॥
en: Defeated by deceitful means, they are now living in the deep forest in great misery. O son of Radha, those greatly powerful car-warriors are now engaged in asceticism.

sa: ऊरू भेत्स्यामि ते पाप गदया भीमवेगया। त्रयोदशानां वर्षाणामन्ते दुर्दूतदेविनः॥
en: "O sinful wretch, as you are a great gambler, I will smash with the fearfully forcible maces, your these two thighs on the expiration of the thirteenth year."

sa: स्तुवन्ति त्वां मुनिगणास्त्वदन्यो नास्तिधर्मवित्। तमब्रवीदृषिः क्रुद्धो वचनं वै महातपाः॥
en: The sages pay their adorations to you. And there is none conversant with religion besides you.” Thereupon that sage of great austerities (Gautama) said to him in anger.

sa: तं स्तम्भयित्वा च्यवनो जुहुवे मन्त्रतोऽनलम्। कृत्यार्थी सुमहातेजा देवं हिंसितुमुद्यतः॥
en: Having paralyzed his arms, Chyavana recited sacred hymns and made offerings to the fire. That greatly effulgent one, having gained his object tried to kill the celestials (Indra).

sa: भृत्यान् सुतान् संविभज्य ततो व्रज यथेप्सितम्। एष वै परमोधर्मोधर्मविद्भिदाहृतः॥
en: And having distributed it among the sons and the attendants, you may go whither you like. This is the highest virtue as instanced by men versed in religion.

sa: पीयमानं समुद्रं तं दृष्ट्वा सेन्द्रास्तदामराः। विस्मयं परमं जग्मुः स्तुतिभिश्चाप्यपूजयन्॥
en: Seeing how the ocean was being drunk up, Indra and the other immortals were filled with great astonishment; and they began to adore him by reciting his praises.

sa: एवं स यजमानश्च विहरंश्च नराधिपः। ररक्ष वसुसम्पूर्णां वसुधां वसुधाधिपः॥
en: Thus the ruler of the earth, the fore-most of men having celebrated the sacrifices and passed his days in joy (with Damayanti), governed the earth abounding in wealth.

sa: यस्मै देवाः प्रयच्छन्ति पुरुषाय पराभवम्। बुद्धिं तस्यापकर्षन्ति सोऽवाचीनानि पश्यति॥
en: The celestial first deprive that man of his reason to whom they ordain defeat and disgrace. It is for this, he sees every thing in a strange light.

sa: यदि वै तस्य वीरस्य बाह्वोर्नाद्याहमन्तरम्। प्रविशामि सुखस्पर्श न भविष्याम्यसंशयम्॥
en: If I am not to enter within the arms of that hero and not to feel the pleasurable touch of his embrace, I will doubtlessly cease to exist.

sa: एवं विलपमाना सा नष्टसंज्ञेव भारत। आरुरोह महद् वेश्म पुण्यश्लोकदिदृक्षया॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, thus lamenting, the lady, as if senseless, mounted the (terrace of the) large palace with the desire of seeing that righteous king.

sa: इत्युक्तवचनं वायुमर्जुनः प्रत्युवाच ह। प्रतिपूज्य महाबाहो तत् तच्छृणु युधिष्ठिर॥
en: After the god of wind had said these words, king Arjuna adored him duly and addressing him answered in these words. Hear, O mightyarmed king, what Arjuna said.

sa: विमुञ्चति न पुण्यात्मा शरण्यः शरणागतान्। आयुरारोग्यमैश्वर्यं वित्तं कामांश्च पुष्कलान्।॥ स ददाति मनुष्येभ्यः स एवाक्षिपते पुनः। शक्रादिषु च देवेषु तस्यैश्वर्यमिहोच्यते॥
en: He would much rather give up his own life and suffer all possible afflictions himself. Long life, health and freedom from disease, affluence, wealth, various kinds of pleasures and enjoyinents, are conferred by him, and it is he also who snatches them away. The lordship and affluence that one sees in Shakra and the Other celestials are, indeed, his.

sa: इत्युक्तः स्थापयामास तस्योरसि मणिं तदा। पार्थस्यामिततेजाः स पितुः स्नेहादपापकृत्॥
en: Thus addressed, the prince who had committed no sin, moved by love for his father, then placed that gem on the breast of Pritha's son of incomparable energy.

sa: उस्थिते पुरुषव्याघ्र पुनर्लक्ष्मीवति प्रभो। दिव्याः सुमनसः पुण्या ववृषे पाकशासनः॥
en: When that foremost of men, O powerful one, awake from the slumber of death with every auspicious sign of life the chastiser of Paka rained down celestial flowers.

sa: यधुच्छिष्टामिमां पत्नीमद्य पश्यति मे गुरुः॥ शप्स्यत्यसंशयं कोपाद् दिव्यज्ञानो महातपाः।
en: If my preceptor on return, sees his wife defiled, he will, forsooth, curse me through anger, for endued with great ascetic merit, he is gifted with spiritual vision.

sa: धर्म एव गतिस्तेषामाचार्योपासनाद् भवेत्। देवलोकं प्रपद्यन्ते ये धर्मं पर्युपासते॥
en: On account of their waiting upon their preceptors with respect their hearts always turn towards virtue. Indeed they, who worship virtuc, attain to the region of the celestials.

sa: भूमिरादिस्तु गन्धानां रसानामाप एव च। रूपाणां ज्योतिरादित्यः स्पर्शानां वायुरुच्यते॥
en: Earth is the source of all smells; and Water of all tastes. The Solar light is the source of all colours; the wind of all sensations of touch.

sa: स तत्र विधिवत् तेन पूजित: पाकशासनिः। भार्याभ्यामभ्यनुज्ञातः प्रायाद् भरतसत्तमः॥
en: The son of the chastiser of Paka then, duly adored by his son and obtaining the permission of his wives, left the spot and proceeded on his way.

sa: यावत्सत्त्वं रजस्तावद् वर्तते नात्र संशयः। यावत्तमश्च सत्त्वं च रजस्तावदिहोच्यते॥
en: As long as goodness exists, so long does Darkness cxist. There is no doubt in this. As long as Ignorance and Goodness exist, so long does Darkness exist.

sa: अमृतं मङ्गलं विद्धि महद्विषममङ्गलम्। ओषध्यो ह्रामृतं सर्वा विषं तेजोऽग्निसम्भवम्॥
en: men Know again that Ambrosia is highly auspicious and that Poison Poison is highly inauspicious. All the herbs are Ambrosia. Poison is born of the energy of fire.

sa: परमार्चितमुच्छ्रित्य ध्वजं सिंहं हिरण्मयम्। प्रययौ पार्थमुद्दिश्य स राजा बभ्रुवाहनः॥
en: Raising his standard which was decorated most beautifully and which bore the device of a lion in gold, the beautiful prince Babhruvahana proceeded against this father for battle.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच ये निष्क्रिया नास्तिका श्रद्दधानाः पापात्मान इन्द्रियार्थे निविष्टाः। यमस्य ते यातनां प्राप्नुवन्ति परं गन्ता धृतराष्ट्रो न तत्र॥
en: Dhritarashtra said They who are destitute of religious acts, they who have no religious faith and are atheists, they who are sinful and are always engaged in pleasing their appetites only they have to go to the region of Yama and suffer the misery he inflicts. Dhritarashtra shall go to a higher region and not there.

sa: अश्विनोः प्रतिसंश्रुत्य च्यवनः पाकशासनम्। प्रोवाच सहितो देवैः सोमपावश्विनौ कुरु॥
en: Having made his promise to the twin Ashvins, Chyavana addressed the chastiser of Paka, saying, Do you make the Ashvins drinkers of Soma with all the other celestials.

sa: पञ्चाशतं सहस्राणि वर्षाणां दिवि मोदते। पक्षे पक्षे गते राजन् योऽश्नीयाद् वर्षमेव तु॥ षण्मासानशनं तस्य भगवानङ्गिराऽब्रवीत्। षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि दिवमावसते च सः॥
en: Such a person enjoys all kinds of happiness in Heaven for fifty thousand years. He who passes a whole year, o king, taking food only at intervals of a fortnight, gains the merit of a continuous fast for six months. This has been said by the illustrious Angirasa himself. Such a man Lives in Heaven for sixty thousand years.

sa: दोग्ध्रीं दत्त्वा सवत्सां तु नक्षत्रे सोमदैवते। गच्छन्ति मानुषाल्लोकात् सर्वलोकमनुत्तमम्॥
en: One giving away a cow with a calf under the constellation called Somadevata (or Mrigashiras), proceeds from this human region to a region in Heaven of great felicity.

sa: मघासु तिलपूर्णानि वर्धमानानि मानवः। प्रदाय पुत्रपशुमानिह प्रेत्य च मोदते॥
en: By making a gift, under the constellation Megha, of earthen dishes filled with sesame, one gets children and animals in this world and acquires happiness in the next.

sa: क्षत्रधर्मेण कौन्तेय जितेयमवनी त्वया॥ भुक्ष्व भोगान् भ्रातृभिश्च सुहृद्धिश्च मनोऽनुगान्।
en: You now fulfill your duties. O Kunti's son, you have conquered this Earth like the Kshatriyas. Do you now, O king enjoy her with your brothers and friends.

sa: अयुतानि च पञ्चाशदृक्षचर्मशतस्य च॥ लोम्नां प्रमाणेन समं ब्रह्मलोके महीयते।
en: Such a man lives also, honoured by all, in the region of Brahma for as many years as there are hairs on the bodies of five thousand bears.

sa: यथाग्निहोत्रं सुहुतं सायं प्रातर्द्विजातिना। तथा दत्तं द्विजातिभ्यो भवत्यथ यतात्मसु।॥
en: One reaps the same merit by making gifts to twiceborn persons of controlled souls which one acquires by properly pouring libations to the sacred fire morning and evening.

sa: अर्धं पापस्य हरति पुरुषस्येह कर्मणः। कूपः प्रवृत्तपानीयः सुप्रवृत्तश्च नित्यशः॥
en: A well full of water and from which various creatures draw water, is said to take off half the sinful deeds of the person who has excavated it.

sa: तथैव देवशर्मापि सभार्यः स महातपाः। निर्भयो बलवृत्रमाच्चचार विजने वने।॥
en: Devasharman also of severe penances, with his wife, began from that day to live in those solitary woods, perfectly fearless of him who had killed Vala and Vritra.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच प्राग्ज्योतिषमथाभ्येत्य व्यचरत् स हयोत्तमः। भगदत्तात्मजस्तत्र निर्ययौ रणकर्कशः॥
en: That foremost of horses then proceeded to the kingdom of Pragjyotisha and began to wander there. At this, Bhagadatta's son, who was greatly courageous in battle, came out.

sa: उज्छमप्राप्तवानेव ब्राह्मणः क्षुच्छ्रमान्वितः। स तथैव क्षुधाविष्टः सार्धं परिजनेन ह॥
en: Unable to obtain of corn, the Brahmana soon became exhausted with hunger and toil. Indeed, with all the members of his family, he had no food to eat.

sa: अलर्को नाम राजर्षिरभवत् सुमहातपाः। धर्मज्ञः सत्यवादी च महात्मा सुदृढव्रतः॥ ससागरान्तां धनुषा विनिर्जित्य महीमिमाम्। कृत्वा सुदुष्करं कर्म मनः सूक्ष्मे समादधे॥
en: There was a royal sage, named of Alarka gifted with the austerest of penances. He knew all duties, was truthful in speech, of high soul, and exceedingly firm in his vows. Having with his bow. conquered the whole earth extending to the seas, and thereby performed a highly difficult fear, he set his mind on that which is subtle.

sa: कृमिभावमनुप्राप्तो वर्षमेकं तु जीवति। ततस्तु निधनं प्राप्तो ब्रह्मयोनौ प्रजायते॥
en: In this form he has to live for a year. Renouncing that form he succeeds in regaining his status as a human being of the twice born order.

sa: मनसश्च गुणश्चिन्ता प्रज्ञया स तु गृह्यते। हृदिस्थश्चेतनो धातुर्मनोज्ञाने विधीयते॥
en: The quality of the mind is thought. That is seized by the understanding. The upholder of consciousness, living in the heart, has been appointed in apprehending the mind.

sa: स तैः परिवृत्तो मेने हर्षबाष्पाविलेक्षणः। राजाऽऽत्मानं गृहगतं पुरेव गजसाह्वये॥
en: Surrounded by them all, the old monarch, with eyes bathed in tears of joy, considered himself as once more staying in the midst of the city of Hastinapur.

sa: प्राणा ह्यन्नं मनुष्याणां तस्माज्जन्तुश्च जायते। अन्ने प्रतिष्ठितो लोकस्तस्मादनं प्रशस्यते॥
en: Food is the vital air of men. From it all creatures originate. All the worlds of living creatures are established upon food. Hence food is highly spoken of.

sa: दैतेया दानवेन्द्राश्च महाकाया महाबलाः। चक्राग्नौ क्षयमापन्ना दावाग्नौ शलभा इव।॥
en: Many sons of Diti, many foremost of Danavas, of huge bodies and vast strength, have died in the fire of Krishna's discus like insects in a forest fire.

sa: आत्मार्थं पाचयन्ननं ममत्वेनोपहन्यते॥ अभक्ष्यभक्षणं चैव मद्यपानं च हन्ति तम्।
en: Digesting food for himself, he becomes ruined through the sense of egoism. The cating of food that should not be caten and the drinking of wine, ruin him.

sa: अवाप्य प्राणसंदेहं कार्कश्येन समार्जितम्। अन्नं दत्त्वा द्विजातिभ्यः शूद्रः पापात्प्रमुच्यते॥
en: That Shudra who acquiring food by hard labour and at the risk of life itself, makes a gift of it to Brahmanas, becomes purged off of every sin.

sa: अधृष्यः सर्वभूतानां विश्वास्यः सर्वजन्तुषु। साधूनां सम्मतो नित्यं भवेन्मांसं विवर्जयन्॥
en: Such a man is incapable of being oppressed by any creature. He enjoys the confidence of all living beings. He always enjoys, besides, the praise of the pious.

sa: इत्येतत् प्रणयात् तात सौभद्रः परवीरहा। कथयामास दुर्घर्षस्तथा चैतन्न संशयः॥
en: These were the words, O son, that that destroyer of hostile heroes, viz., the son of Subhadra, that irresistible hero, said to Uttara from his love for her.

sa: जिह्वा चक्षुस्तथा श्रोत्रं वाङ्मनो बुद्धिरेव च। न गन्धानधिगच्छन्ति घ्राणस्तानधिगच्छति॥
en: The tongue, the eye, the ear too, the skin, the mind, and the understanding, do not succeed in apprehending smells. It is the nose alone which apprehends them.

sa: स्वमांसं परमांसेन यो वर्धयितुमिच्छति। नास्ति क्षुद्रतरस्तस्मात् स नृशंसतरो नरः॥
en: That man who wishes to increase his own flesh by the meat of another living creature is such that there is none meaner and more cruel than he.

sa: तत्रापि राजा प्रीतात्मा यथादिष्टमथाकरोत्। ततोऽस्य भगवान् प्रीतो बभूव मुनिसत्तमः॥
en: At this deed also, king Kushika showed no mark of dissatisfaction. He did as the Rishi ordered. Seeing all this, that illustrious and best of ascetics became pleased.

sa: एष धर्मो मया देवि वानप्रस्थाश्रितः शुभः। विस्तरेणाय सम्पन्नो यथास्थूलमुदाहृतः॥
en: O auspicious goddess, I have thus recited to you, in brief, the outlines of the religion that is followed by hermits and that has many practices in detail.

sa: मयाभिपन्नाः सिध्यन्ते ऋषयो देवतास्तथा। यान् नाविशाम्यहं गावस्ते विनश्यन्ति सर्वशः॥
en: Indeed, the Rishis and the celestials, only when they are endued with me, become successful. You kine, those beings meet with destruction into whom I do not enter.

sa: पितॄणां देवतानां च मनुष्योरगरक्षसाम्। पुराप्येते महाभागा ब्राह्मणा वै जनाधिप॥
en: The Brahmanas, O king, who are highly blessed are older in respect of their origin than the departed manes, the deities human beings, the Snakes, and the Rakshasas.

sa: अविनाशोऽस्य सत्त्वस्य नियतो यदि भारत। भित्त्वा शरीरं भूतानामहिंसां प्रतिपद्यते॥
en: And if, O Bharata, it be true that no creature is ever killed, then one commits no sin for the death of a creature by destroying its body.

sa: वर्धमानतिलं श्राद्धमक्षयं मनुरब्रवीत्। सर्वेष्वेव तु भोज्येषु तिलाः प्राधान्यतः स्मृताः॥
en: Manu has said that if a Shraddha is performed with profuse sesame, such Shraddha becomes inexhaustible. Of all sorts of food, sesame seeds are considered as the best.

sa: अभिमन्यो कुशलिनो मातुलास्ते महारथाः। कुशलं चाब्रुवन् सर्वे त्वां युयुत्सुमिहागतम्॥
en: Alas, O Abhimanyu, your maternal uncles, powerful car-warriors, are all hale. They used to bless you when they saw you come here prepared to go out for battle.

sa: कुप्यभागी भवेन्मर्त्यः कुर्वन्नेकादशीं नृप। ब्रह्मवर्चस्विनः पुत्रा जायन्ते तस्य वेश्मनि॥
en: By performing it on the eleventh day one gets valuable cloths and utensils. Such a man also gets many sons all of whom become endued with Brahma splendour.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच उक्तं पितामहेनदं गवां दानमनुत्तमम्। विशेषेण नरेन्द्राणामिह धर्ममवेक्षताम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said You have, O grandfather, expounded to me the highly meritorious gift of kine. In the case of kings performing their duties, that gift is most meritorious.

sa: त्रिविधानीह वृत्तानि नरस्याहुर्मनीषिणः। पुण्यमन्यत् पापमन्यन्न पुण्यं न च पापकम्॥
en: Wise men have said that human beings in this world have three kinds of conduct. Some are righteous; some are sinful; and some are neither righteous nor sinful.

sa: कश्चिद् वाग्बुद्धिसम्पन्नो ब्राह्मणो विजने वने। गृहीतः कृच्छ्रमापन्नो रक्षसा भक्षयिष्यता॥
en: A certain Brahmana, gifted with eloquence and intelligence fell into distress, for he was seized in a lone forest by a Rakshasa who wished to feed on him.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नस्त्वभून्नेता पाण्डवानां महास्त्रवित्। गुप्तो भीमेन मेधावी मित्रेण वरुणो यथा॥
en: Dhrishtadyumna familiar with many powerful weapons, and gifted with great intelligence, became became the leader of the Pandavas. He was protected by Bhima like Varuna protected by Mitra.

sa: यथात्र कश्चिन्मेधावी दृष्टात्मा पूर्वजन्मनि। यत् प्रवक्ष्यामि तत् सर्वं यथावदुपपद्यते॥
en: All that I say is proper and correct, as a person who has intelligence and who has seen his Soul, would say on this subject of previous births.

sa: तथाऽचारबलं चैव परस्परसमं नृप। विज्ञेयं बहुकालेषु राज्ञा काल उपस्थिते॥
en: The power of spies is considered by the king as equal in efficacy to either of the above, on many occasions, when the tiine comes for applying each.

sa: आदित्योदयसम्प्राप्ते विधिमन्त्रपुरस्कृतम्। ददाति काञ्चनं यो वै दुःस्वप्नं प्रतिहन्ति सः॥
en: That person who, at sunrise, makes a gift of gold according to the ordinance and with proper Mantras, succeeds in warding off the evils foreshadowed by ominous dreams.

sa: तस्मात् सर्वे पावकस्तु न तत्रासीच्छापकाले भृगूद्वह। देवा देव्यास्तथा शापादनपत्यास्ततोऽभवन्॥
en: O perpetuator of Bhrigu's race, the deity of fire was not there. It is on account of this curse of the goddess that the deities have become childless.

sa: तेन चात्मानुशिष्टो मे पुत्रत्वे मुनिसत्तमाः। तेजसोऽर्धेन पुत्रस्ते भवितेति वृषध्वजः॥
en: The Grandfather, ye foremost of ascetics, told my soul that the energy of the great god having the bull for his embalmer would take birth as my son.

sa: ततस्त्रैलोक्यमृषयो व्यचिन्वन्त सुरैः सह। काङ्क्षन्तो दर्शनं वह्नः सर्वे तद्गतमानसाः॥
en: The gods and the Rishis then searched every portion of the three worlds their hearts being busy with the thought of Agni and eagerly desiring to see him.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ततस्त्वृषिगणाः सर्वे पितरश्च सदेवताः। अरुन्धतीं तपोवृद्धामपृच्छन्त समाहिताः॥
en: Bhishma said The diverse Rishis there assembled together with the departed Manes and the deities, then, with rapt attention, asked Arundhati who was gifted with great ascetic merit.

sa: अवाप्तार्थोऽहमद्येह भवांश्च पुरुषादकः। भवत्सकाशमागन्तुं क्षमं मम न वेति वै॥
en: As for myself, I have now obtained the fruition of my wishes. You, again, are a cannibal. Is it proper for me to return to you or not.

sa: पानीयस्य प्रदानेन कीर्तिर्भवति शाश्वती। अन्नस्य तु प्रदानेन तृप्यन्ते कामभोगतः॥
en: By making gifts of water and other drinks, one acquires eternal fame on account of high achievements. By making gifts of food, one acquires various articles of enjoyment.

sa: यदिदानीमहं ब्रूयामस्मिन् काल उपस्थिते॥ तथा भवद्भिः कर्तव्यमविचार्य वचो मम।
en: What I shall now say in view of the opportunity that has come, should be done by you all even as disciples accomplish the orders of their preceptors.

sa: संजुहावात्मनाऽऽत्मानं स्वयमेव तदा प्रभो। यज्ञं च शोभयामास बहुरूपं पिनाकधृत्॥
en: The powerful Lord of All then poured libations himself into his own self. Indeed, the holder of Pinaka caused that Sacrifice of multifarious form to look highly beautiful.

sa: पापमाचरतां घोरं लोकस्याप्रियमिच्छताम्। अहमासादितो राज्ञा प्राणान् हन्तुं निशाचर ॥
en: O ranger of the night, it is to take the lives of the perpetrators of dreadful sins, who wish ill to men, that I the king have come.

sa: कामार्थों लिप्समानस्तु धर्ममेवादितश्चरेत्। न हि धर्मादपैत्यर्थः कामो वाऽपि कदाचन॥
en: The man, who is desirous of gaining the object of desire or worldly profit, must first of all practice virtue; desire or profit is seldom detached from virtue.

sa: बलाबलममित्राणां श्रोतुमिच्छामि कौरव। प्रभातायां रजन्यां वै इदं युद्धं भविष्यति॥
en: O son of Kuru, I desire to hear of the strength and weakness of the enemies for the fight is to take place at the dawn of night.”

sa: त्वया पुनरनार्येण जिह्ममार्गेण पार्थिवाः॥ स्वधर्ममनुतिष्ठन्तो वयं चान्ये च घातिताः।
en: By adopting the most wily and unfair means you have caused the death of many kings observant of the duties of their order and of ourselves as well.'

sa: चक्षुश्च जिह्वा घ्राणं च पञ्चमम्। सर्गं तु षष्ठमित्याहुर्बहुचिन्तात्मकं स्मृतम्॥
en: The creation of the Ear, the Skin, the Eye, the Tongue, and the Scent, forms the sixth and is considered as having for its essence multiplicity of thought.

sa: युद्धे हि क्षत्रियांस्तात पाण्डवानां जयैषिणः। सर्वानन्यान् हनिष्यामि सम्प्राप्तान रणमूर्धनि॥
en: I will, O sire, slay all other Kshatriyas in battle, who, desirous of victory to the Pandavas, shall happen to encounter me in the van of the battle.'

sa: एवं निःक्षत्रिये लोके कृते तेन महर्षिणा। ततः संभूय सर्वाभिः क्षत्रियाभिः समन्ततः॥ उत्पादितान्यपत्यानि ब्राह्मणैर्वेदपारगैः। पाणिग्राहस्य तनय इति वेदेषु निश्चितम्॥
en: When the earth was thus in olden time made Kshatriya-less by that great Rishi, the Kshatriya women raised children by the Brahmanas, learned in the Vedas. They went to the Brahmanas not lustfully, but from virtuous motives. It is said in the Vedas that the son so raised belongs to him that had married the mother.

sa: इन्द्र उवाच विनष्टायां दण्डनीत्यां राजधर्मे निराकृते। सम्प्रमुह्यन्ति भूतानि राजदौरात्म्यतोऽनघ॥
en: Indra said When the kingly duties are lost as well as the science of punishment, all creatures become exceedingly exercised, O sinless one, for the oppression of kings.

sa: अर्चयामास सुप्रीतो भगवान् गोवृषध्वजः। रुद्रमग्निं द्विजाः प्राहू रुद्रसूनुस्ततस्तु सः॥
en: That exalted god Vrishadhvaja (Siva) honoured him with a joyous heart. That deity is called Rudra by the Brahmanas and therefore Skanda is called the son of Rudra.

sa: ज्ञात्वा सम्प्रस्थितं देवी वानरं पवनात्मजम्॥ बाष्पगद्गदया वाचा मैथिली वाक्यमब्रवीत्।
en: Seeing that (Hanumān) was about to set out, that exalted one, Mithila's daughter, addressed that monkey, son to the Wind-god, in words choked by the vapour of grief.

sa: ततस्त्रेतायुगं नाम मानवानां वपुष्मताम्॥ क्षत्रिया यत्र जायन्ते पूर्वेण तपसान्विताः। वीर्येण तपसा चैव तेऽधिकाः पूर्वजन्मनि॥ मानवा ये महात्मानस्तत्र त्रेतायुगे युगे।
en: There upon at the end of the golden age, Brāhmaṇa's understanding became loose and the Tretā Yuga set in. At this age Kşatriyas, gifted with the power acquired by pristine asceticism, were born. And those men, intent upon austere penances, that were born in the Tretā age, were more powerful and greater devotees than those in the former age.

sa: तयोरेकतरे मार्गे यदेनमभिसन्नयेत्। न सुखं प्राप्य संहष्येन्नासुखं प्राप्य संज्वरेत्॥
en: If he could ascribe either of them to the work of Destiny, he would then be indifferent w either happiness or misery as they fall to his share,
